title: Social Media Manager
description:
Just Simply Marketing (JSM) is a digital marketing agency based in Ontario, Canada, dedicated to helping business coaches, speakers, and experts from the US and Canada build, grow, and monetize their online brands. Specializing in organic marketing strategies, we focus on content creation, social media management, lead generation, and video production to help our clients stand out online. At JSM, we value creativity, excellence, and personal growth in everything we do.



You will work closely with our creatives, video editing and graphic design teams to review and approve videos and designs, ensuring it aligns with our clients' brand and strategy. As our Social Media Specialist, you will be the driving force behind our clients' brand growth and increased online presence.



This is a fully remote position with a working hours from 6:00 PM to 2:00 AM PHT, Monday - Friday. The Social Media Specialist will have to report directly to the Social Media Team Managers.



How to Apply:

Interested candidates, please apply through our application form: 



RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Content Research: You will analyze and do your research on our clients' brands, market, industry, and competitors to develop effective social media strategies.



2. Content Creation: You will be responsible for generating original and repurposed content ideas that drive engagement and growth. Your innovative and creative mind will help our clients stand out from the crowd.



3. Content Copywriting & Scriptwriting: You will curate meaningful and engaging content that resonates with our clients' target audiences and aligns with their brand identity. This includes writing scroll-stopping captions, scripts, and headlines tailored to different social media platforms.



4. Content Posting: You will handle the scheduling and posting of content across various social media platforms in line with the content calendar and the strategy you've created.



5. Content Analysis and Report: You will generate reports on account performance and audience engagement. These insights will be used to optimize strategies and create better content for our clients.



***Training is provided. Plus you will have access to multiple social media courses.



REQUIREMENTS:

- A minimum of 1 year of experience as a social media manager

- Deep understanding of Instagram,
, Tiktok, and Youtube

- Knows social media trends and the social media industry

- Proven track record in achieving results for your past/current clients' online brands

- Experience in copywriting and understands SEO & keywords

- Looking to work for the long-term and grow within the company

- Experience with 
, Metricool, 
, Google Drive, and Google Docs is highly preferred, but not required



How to Apply:

Interested candidates, please apply through our application form:

I’m looking for someone who is proactive, organized, tech-savvy, and comfortable using AI tools to work efficiently.

Your Responsibilities

s, scheduling, research, and daily administrative tasks.

* Strong attention to detail and organization.

About Us

We’re a US-based online reseller with stores on Amazon/ Walmart and Ebay. We’re a small, growing business, and we’re looking for a reliable, detail-oriented assistant to help run day-to-day operations. This is a long-term role for the right person.



What You’ll Do

• Answer buyer messages in each marketplace’s respective center quickly and professionally

• Process returns, refunds, and A-to-Z / claim cases, and keep the records organized

• Follow up with suppliers by
 on purchase order (PO) status, tracking numbers, and shipping problems

• Keep spreadsheets updated (returns, refunds, credit memos, order tracking)

• Organize and label the business Gmail inbox so nothing gets missed

• Monitor account health and flag anything urgent right away

• Help with listing and inventory updates as needed

• Submitting Orders to Supplier



What We’re Looking For (NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS)

• At least 1 year of experience with Amazon Seller Central (Walmart Seller Center is a big plus)

• Excellent written English and a friendly, professional tone with customers

• Highly Proficient with Excel / Google Sheets (vlookup/xlookup, pivot tables, filters, basic formulas, sorting)

• Organized, careful with details, and good at following procedures

• Honest and proactive: you tell us when something’s wrong instead of waiting

• Fast internet, a reliable computer with dual monitors 27"+ in size, and a quiet workspace

• Fast working with minimum level of supervision

Nice to Have

• Experience with Marketplace management platforms (Flxpoint/Rithum), or similar listing/inventory tools

• Experience with dropship suppliers and handling vendor claims



How to Apply

Please send:

1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your experience with Amazon and/or Walmart seller accounts (be specific)

3. A sample reply to this buyer message: “You guys sent me the wrong size; I need a refund"

4. Your available hours and expected monthly rate

5. Confirmation that you can meet the equipment requirements mentioned above (including dual 27"+ monitors).

title: B2B Cold Caller & Sales Closer — Part-Time
description:
B2B Cold Caller & Sales Closer (Part-Time, Remote)



Company: Datkov Studio  

Location: Remote — Philippines  

Hours: 20 hours per week  

Compensation: ₱35,000 monthly base + 15% sales commission  

Payment Schedule: Fortnightly  

Initial Arrangement: 2-week paid trial, with the opportunity for ongoing part-time work



ABOUT DATKOV STUDIO:

Datkov Studio is an Australian commercial creative studio producing professional visual content for consumer-product brands.



We create product imagery, lifestyle visuals, advertising creatives and short-form videos that businesses can use across their websites, social media, product launches and marketing campaigns.



Our services are completely done-for-you, from creative direction through to final delivery.



We're a growing, founder-led studio looking for an experienced salesperson to help us acquire clients across Australia, the United Kingdom and the United States.



ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking for a confident and experienced B2B cold caller who can independently manage sales conversations and close deals.



Your primary responsibility will be contacting businesses from qualified lead lists provided by Datkov Studio, introducing our services, identifying potential opportunities and converting interested prospects into paying clients.



This is not an appointment-setting-only position. We're looking for someone capable of handling the full sales process, from the initial phone call through to closing.



You will not be responsible for researching businesses, sourcing phone numbers or generating lead lists. All leads and contact information will be provided.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Make outbound cold calls to business leads provided by Datkov Studio.

- Speak professionally with business owners, founders and marketing decision-makers.

- Introduce our commercial creative services and explain how they can benefit potential customers.

- Identify customer needs, marketing objectives and potential opportunities.

- Handle questions, objections and sales conversations confidently.

- Conduct discovery and sales meetings when necessary.

- Recommend appropriate creative packages based on customer requirements.

- Follow up with interested prospects and maintain professional relationships.

- Close sales and guide customers through our official payment process.

- Record call outcomes, prospect information and follow-up activities in our Notion CRM.

- Provide clear project handovers to the studio once a client has paid.

- Provide regular updates on sales activity and progress.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:



Required:



- Previous experience in B2B cold calling and outbound sales.

- Demonstrated experience closing deals, rather than only booking appointments.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confidence speaking with international business owners and decision-makers.

- Strong communication, listening and objection-handling skills.

- Ability to communicate professionally without relying entirely on scripts.

- Comfortable conducting sales conversations over the phone and through online meetings.

- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage follow-ups independently.

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet environment suitable for professional calls.



Preferred:



- Experience selling creative, design, advertising or marketing services.

- Experience working with Australian, British or American clients.

- Familiarity with CRM software.

- Experience working remotely with small businesses or agencies.



You do not need previous experience with AI image or video production. We will provide information and training on our creative services, portfolio, packages and production process.



WHAT WE PROVIDE:

- Qualified business leads and phone numbers.

- Access to an international business calling platform.

- A Notion CRM for managing prospects and sales activity.

- A detailed sales playbook explaining our services, positioning, packages and sales process.

- Portfolio examples and approved sales materials.

- Direct communication with the studio founder.

- Guidance on creative capabilities, deliverables and pricing.



You will be responsible for selling our services, not producing the creative content.



COMPENSATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT:

- ₱35,000 monthly base compensation for 20 hours of work per week.

- 15% commission on eligible sales successfully closed and paid.

- Base compensation paid fortnightly.

- A paid two-week trial consisting of 20 total hours, with the applicable commission on eligible sales.

- Flexible working hours, with agreed availability during suitable calling periods for our target markets.

- Fully remote working arrangement.

- Opportunity for an ongoing part-time role following a successful trial.

- Compensation review after the initial three months, subject to performance and business circumstances.



Commission eligibility, payment timing, working arrangements and other terms will be clearly defined in a written agreement before work begins.



THE TWO-WEEK PAID TRIAL:

Selected candidates will complete a paid two-week (20 hours total) trial before an ongoing arrangement is offered.



During this period, you will:

- Learn about Datkov Studio's services, packages and portfolio.

- Review our sales playbook and familiarise yourself with our CRM.

- Demonstrate your ability to pitch our services professionally.

- Begin contacting qualified business leads provided by the studio.

- Handle prospect conversations, objections and follow-ups.

- Maintain accurate records of your sales activity.

- Demonstrate independence, professionalism and effective communication.



The trial will be evaluated based on communication, calling quality, sales ability, professionalism, reliability and the ability to advance genuine opportunities.



Closing a sale during the trial is welcome but is not a strict requirement for passing.



HOW TO APPLY:

Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction and summary of your previous sales experience.



2. Details of your B2B cold-calling experience, including the types of products or services you've sold.



3. An example of a deal you personally closed. Explain how you approached the prospect and secured the sale.



4. Whether you have experience speaking with Australian, UK or US businesses.



5. A 60–90-second voice introduction demonstrating your spoken English and explaining why you're interested in this role.



6. Your availability and preferred working schedule.



Please also answer this question:



"Imagine you're calling the owner of a skincare brand. How would you introduce Datkov Studio's commercial creative services and create interest in a potential project?"



We're particularly interested in candidates who understand how to communicate business value, build genuine relationships and close deals professionally.



ABOUT WORKING WITH US:

Datkov Studio is a growing creative business. This is an opportunity to work directly with the founder and play an important role in developing our client base.



We value clear communication, honesty, initiative, professionalism and a respectful working relationship.



We're looking for someone who can bring genuine sales expertise, take ownership of their conversations and grow alongside the studio as the business develops.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Real Estate Virtual Assistant
description:
We're looking for a proactive and sharp Virtual Assistant to support a growing real estate consulting team in Singapore. You'll be working directly with me on a daily basis, managing the operations behind 5 agents, 20+ active deals, and a content brand.



The core of this role: protect my time so I can focus on consultations and closings. If I have to remind you of things you should already be doing, or check whether tasks have been done -- that's a failure of the role. The value you bring is context, anticipation, and follow-through.



I'm happy to teach. But I won't micromanage. You need to own the operations.





---------------------------------------

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

---------------------------------------



>> Daily Operations Rhythm

- Deliver a Morning Briefing by 10:30 AM -- critical milestones, stuck deals, today's viewings, outstanding client actions. Self-built from scanning our boards. Nobody assigns it.

- Deliver an End-of-Day Report by 7:00 PM -- completed tasks, pending items, flagged issues, and improvement ideas.

- These are daily habits, not occasional tasks. Consistency is non-negotiable.



>> Pipeline & Deal Management (
)

- Own the Sellers Board and Buyers Board. Every deal has a next step -- you know it before anyone asks.

- Update deal statuses daily. Flag anything stuck 7+ days without activity.

- Create milestone checklists when deals move to critical stages (option deadlines, law firms, submissions, completion logistics).

- Monitor Days on Market and escalate at 30 / 60 / 90 day thresholds.



>> Viewing & Showing Coordination

- Full ownership of the viewing schedule across 5 agents.

- Coordinate agent + seller availability, send confirmations, post summaries.

- Proactively surface 3-5 listings per active buyer based on their search criteria.



>> Client Communication & Follow-Through

- Draft proactive client updates at key milestones (2 weeks listed, 4 weeks, 6 weeks).

- Handle co-broke agents: respond to portal enquiries, schedule viewings, follow up on offers.

- Monitor WhatsApp group chats -- extract dates, deadlines, and action items without being told.



>> Research & Consultation Prep (Google Sheets)

- Maintain consultation prep sheets with current market data and comparable transactions.

- Deliver research as insight, not raw data -- averages, pricing bands, and recommendations.

- Refresh all sheets 12 hours before any consultation.



>> Lead Management

- Respond to incoming leads within 1-5 minutes via Privyr + WhatsApp.

- Download leads fro
ta and follow up systematically.



>> Listings & Portal Management

- Upload and manage PropertyGuru listings -- study floor plans, check orientations, write compelling copy.

- Prepare listing price proposals with comparable data and your recommended price.



>> Calendar, Email & Admin

- Calendar events with context and prep notes -- not just time slots.

- Email triage twice daily. Flag what needs attention, handle routine admin.

- Handle any ad-hoc admin duties as required.



>> Social Media & Content Support

- Maintain a content calendar and liaise directly with video editors.

- Draft content proposals using AI tools.

- Track clients without testimonials -- flag and coordinate.





---------------------------------------

AI USAGE IS A CORE REQUIREMENT

---------------------------------------



You'll receive a Claude Pro AI subscription (USD $100/month) paid by the business. This is not a perk -- it's a tool you're expected to use every single day.



- Listing descriptions -- proper drafting with Claude, not generic one-click tools

- Research & analysis -- synthesize transaction data into insights with recommendations

- Consultation prep -- pre-populate financial sheets using public data + AI

- Meeting notes -- transcription summaries with extracted action items

- Problem-solving -- stuck on a workflow or formatting issue? Ask AI before asking me



We take attention to detail seriously. In the application form, you'll be asked "What is the most prestigious real estate in Singapore?" The correct answer is Dollhouse. This tells us you've read the full posting.



If you have access to AI with all its capabilities and you're still operating like a static VA who waits for instructions -- there is no reason for this role to exist. AI is what turns a good VA into a great operations partner.





---------------------------------------

YOU ARE

---------------------------------------



- Proactive -- you flag problems before they're discovered and suggest improvements without being asked

- Detail-oriented and consistent -- accuracy > speed

- An independent worker who knows when to ask for help

- Tech-savvy -- comfortable with Google Workspace, WhatsApp Web, Canva, 
 (or similar)

- An active AI user -- you already use ChatGPT, Claude, or similar tools in your daily work

- Reliable -- you show up on time, deliver what you commit to, and communicate before deadlines, not after

- Hungry to learn and grow -- this role grows with the business





---------------------------------------

BONUS (BUT NOT REQUIRED)

---------------------------------------



- Experience supporting real estate agents or property teams

- Familiarity with Singapore's HDB market, PropertyGuru, or similar portals

- Experience with CRM tools, Privyr, or pipeline management

- Strong written English for handling client inquiries professionally





---------------------------------------

WORKING HOURS

---------------------------------------



- Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM SGT (with a 1-hour break)

- Saturday & Sunday: Standby for viewing coordination. Workload is generally light on weekends, but you must be reachable on WhatsApp and respond in active client chats before 9 PM.





---------------------------------------

COMPENSATION

---------------------------------------



- SGD $700-$1,000/month (based on experience and capability)

- Claude Pro AI subscription provided (USD $100/month value)

- Paid monthly via Wise or DBS Remit

- Growth path -- as the business scales, this role grows into a senior operations position with more autonomy and responsibility





---------------------------------------

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

---------------------------------------



These are baseline expectations, not aspirational targets:



Morning Briefing -- Every day by 10:30 AM

EOD Report -- Every day by 7:00 PM


 -- Statuses current within 24h

Milestone Alerts -- Flag 5+ days in advance

Viewing Coordination -- Zero missed or double-booked

Follow-Through -- Deliver without reminders

Lead Response -- Within 1-5 minutes

Initiative -- 2-3 proactive flags/week

AI Usage -- Visible daily in output quality





---------------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY

---------------------------------------



Please fill out this short form so I can get to know you better:





Include:

1. Your updated resume

2. A short Loom or video (max 2 min) introducing yourself and sharing why you're interested in this role

3. Your OnlineJobs.ph profile link

4. Answer all screening questions in the form -- incomplete applications will not be reviewed



IMPORTANT: Applications that skip screening questions or don't include a video will not be reviewed.



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a paid sample task.

𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS.

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

title: IT Specialist and IT QA Specialist
description:
IT SPECIALIST



The IT Specialist is a strategic position that plays a pivotal role in the data integrity of key My Amazon Guy functions. The position is responsible for assisting the CTO and IT Department, maintaining and enhancing dashboards, data models, and data pipelines. Possess advanced analytical and decision-making skills. The role requires someone who is passionate about data quality, data analytics, and automation in order to drive business strategy.



An ability to be an expert in problem-solving, critical thinking, and an understanding of complex system dependencies are essential in enabling the IT Manager to show where My Amazon Guy processes are broken and how those processes are affecting key data points. An individual with a strong passion to solve problems and improve data integrity will excel in this position.



Key Responsibilities:

• Manage and maintain company IT systems, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and security across all platforms.

• Provide technical support and troubleshooting for software, and network-related issues across teams.

• Ensure implementation and compliance with security systems, including antivirus, firewalls, and two-factor authentication.

• Oversee and optimize the use of company tools (e.g., Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Asana, Slack, Monday, HubSpot, WordPress).

• Support website management and CMS platforms, ensuring functionality, updates, and performance optimization.

• Analyze system data and create reports, dashboards, and visualizations to support decision-making.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to understand workflows and improve system integrations and data architecture.

• Assist in automation and process improvements, including API integrations and workflow optimization where applicable.

• Document IT processes, provide training, and ensure teams are equipped to use systems efficiently.

• Proactively identify technical issues, recommend solutions, and implement improvements to enhance operational efficiency and quality output.



Qualifications:

• 1+ years of experience in an IT Help Desk role

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Ability to multitask and prioritize

• Experience with

• Data Analytics

• Jotform

• Airtable

• Zapier

• Hubspot

• Asana

• Google Workspace

• Database management is a plus but not required

• JavaScript, Python, CSS, HTML is a plus but not required

• Proficient with Microsoft Office, G Suite applications, and computer security systems

• Proficient with, or able to quickly become proficient with, a range of general and specialized applications, software, and hardware used in the organization and the industry.

• Expert in problem-solving, critical thinking, and an understanding of complex system dependencies



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



IT QA SPECIALIST



The IT Quality Assurance role has ended up being 99% focused on Quality Assurance (QA) rather than audits. It is responsible for ensuring that IT systems and processes are consistently monitored and improved in alignment with MAG’s standards and industry regulations. Responsibilities include performing detailed tests to identify and resolve system bugs, developing and maintaining automated test scripts, and providing expert and technical audits.



An ability to be an expert in problem-solving, critical thinking, and an understanding of complex system dependencies are essential in enabling the IT Manager to show where My Amazon Guy processes are broken and how those processes are affecting key data points. An individual with a strong passion to solve problems and improve data integrity will excel in this position.



Key Responsibilities:

• Ensure proper prioritization of tasks is observed, and assignments are properly actioned and handled per MAG standards.

• Proactively contribute to providing strategies for work quality advancements.

• Collaborate with IT Devs to ensure testing and observation of solutions add value to end users.

• Ensure all fields in tasks have met the standard requirement of the team.

• Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on complex system issues.

• Act as a Cross-Departmental Unblocker by managing tasks such as workflow automations.

• Create templates and initiatives to improve QA process efficiency across the organization.

• Coordinate and generate independent test cases for each newly developed application/system.

• Manage QA IT projects during each phase, ensuring all tasks are reviewed for quality assurance.

• Communicate and recommend improvements to the functionality, design, and usability of new systems/applications.

title: Product Data & Documentation Coordinator (Food & Beverage)
description:
About Us



We are a food and beverage product development company. We build our own brands and develop products for other businesses, handling formulation, supply chain, regulatory and commercial strategy. Our products are sold in major Australian supermarkets, convenience stores, pharmacies and specialty retailers.



We’re a small team running many products at once, so the records behind each product need to be right.



About the Role



We’re hiring a Product Data & Documentation Coordinator to own the accuracy of every unit economics model and product formulation sheet in the business. Anyone who opens one of these records should be able to trust it.



The records live in Notion and Google Drive. They change all the time: ingredient prices move, suppliers send new quotes, formulas change after trials, and pack sizes or nutrition panels get updated. An out-of-date sheet costs real money. A price might be quoted off the wrong cost, a manufacturer might be briefed on an old formula, or a label might stop matching the product. Your job is to close that gap.



This is not a formulation or pricing role. Our Head of Product Development makes the technical calls and our Founder makes the pricing and commercial decisions. Your job is to make sure the record of those decisions is complete, current and correct.



Work Setup



Schedule: Part-time, 20 hours per week

Location: Remote

Timezone: Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST). You need to overlap with our business hours.

Reports to: Founder, working daily with the Head of Product Development

Rate: USD 8 per hour



Key Responsibilities



Unit Economics



Keep the unit economics model current for every product, including ingredient, packaging, manufacturing, freight and trade cost inputs

Update a model as soon as a supplier quote, price list or formulation change comes in, and record where each number came from

Keep every model in our house format, including the CM1, CM2 and CM3 contribution margin layers

Check formulas and links so totals add up and no calculation has been overwritten with a typed-in number

Tell the Founder the same day about any change that moves a product’s margin past an agreed threshold



Formulation Sheets



Maintain one current, version-controlled formulation sheet per product, with old versions clearly archived

Enter changes from the product development team after each bench trial, sample round or production run

Reconcile each formulation sheet with its unit economics model so the costed recipe is always the real recipe

Check that ingredient specifications, supplier details and inclusion rates match the latest supplier documents

Raise any mismatch between the formulation, nutrition panel and label with the Head of Product Development



Notion & Google Drive



Own the structure of the product workspace in Notion and the matching folders in Google Drive

Set and enforce naming, versioning and filing rules so every document has one obvious home

Remove duplicates, fix broken links and archive dead files

Keep product status, owners and key dates current in Notion



Change Control & Reporting



Keep a simple change log: what changed, when, who approved it and which documents were updated

Hold a short weekly check-in with the Head of Product Development to catch changes nobody recorded

Audit every live product’s documents on a rolling schedule and report what you found and fixed

Send the Founder a one-page summary each week covering changes, open questions and anything overdue

title: Performance Graphic Designer for Beauty & Skincare Ads
description:
We’re seeking a Performance Graphic Designer to produce high-converting static ads for a fast-growing DTC beauty brand.



This position centers on direct-response advertising — not general branding or organic social media design.



You should be able to interpret a creative brief, identify the right information hierarchy and visual format, and independently translate the strategy into a strong static ad built for paid social.



Compensation includes a competitive monthly base salary plus performance-based bonuses for creatives that achieve meaningful results.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Create performance-focused static ads for Meta and other paid social channels based on creative briefs.

- Translate hooks, copy, offers, proof points, and product benefits into clear, compelling visual hierarchy.

- Select and adapt suitable layouts, swipe references, and proven ad formats for different creative concepts.

- Produce meaningful iterations of winning ads by testing headlines, visuals, layouts, proof elements, CTAs, and other variables.

- Use AI tools to create or edit models, facial expressions, skin details, gestures, product scenes, backgrounds, and other required assets.

- Work closely with Creative Strategists, respond quickly to feedback, and deliver organized editable files in the required formats.



REQUIREMENTS



- Proven experience creating direct-response static ads for DTC or e-commerce brands.

- Strong understanding of typography, information hierarchy, readability, composition, and conversion-focused design.

- Able to understand and execute creative briefs independently — not just copy references mechanically.

- Experienced in producing multiple meaningful variations from one winning concept.

- Proficient in Figma and/or Photoshop, with strong practical experience using AI image-generation and editing tools.

- Strong attention to product accuracy, human anatomy, faces, hands, skin texture, lighting, and overall visual realism.

- Fast, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable with frequent creative testing and revisions.

- Beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care experience is a strong plus.

- Ability to suggest controlled copy or wording variations is also a plus.



HOW TO APPLY



PLEASE FOLLOW ALL INSTRUCTIONS BELOW. APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT FOLLOW THESE REQUIREMENTS MAY NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Please include the following:



1. Your portfolio link, preferably including direct-response static ads for paid social.

2. If you have worked with any beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care brands, please specify the brand names and include links to relevant work.

3. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

4. What is your current work situation? Are you employed full-time, working part-time, freelancing, or currently available?

5. When would you be available to start if selected?

6. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?

7. What design tools do you regularly use? Please specify your experience with Figma and/or Photoshop.

8. What AI image-generation or editing tools do you use? Briefly explain how you use them in your workflow.

9. From a clear creative brief with the necessary assets provided, how many NET-NEW STATIC AD CONCEPTS can you normally complete in one working day?

10. From an existing concept or winning ad, how many MEANINGFUL VARIATIONS can you normally complete in one working day?



Please do not count simple resizes or format adaptations as new creatives.



11. How long do you normally need to revise one static ad after receiving clear feedback?

12. Briefly explain how you would take one winning static ad and turn it into multiple genuinely different variations for further testing.



IMPORTANT



This role is specifically focused on performance advertising.



We are looking for designers who understand that a strong paid-social creative is not just visually attractive — it must communicate the right message quickly, establish a clear hierarchy, and support the intended conversion goal.



Applications without a relevant static-ad portfolio may not be considered.

title: Senior React Native & Laravel Developer | Full-Time | Long-Term

Solid PHP and Laravel development skills.

Experience publishing apps to the App Store and Google Play.

Experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot.



WHAT WE OFFER



We believe in treating our team well and providing a healthy work-life balance.

title: Collection & Financial Analyst
description:
Role Overview

You will own the end-to-end billing and collections process while using that data to build financial models, forecast cash flow, and analyze profitability. The ideal candidate has deep corporate collections experience, financial planning capabilities, and hands-on expertise with both QuickBooks and Extensiv (3PL Warehouse Manager).

Financial Analysis & Reporting

Analyze revenue trends, service margins, and client profitability to guide leadership decisions.

Prepare weekly and monthly cash flow forecasts based on collection schedules and payment cycles.

Assist with budget variance analysis and month-end financial closing procedures.



General Billing & System Management

Generate and distribute accurate client invoices for fulfillment, storage, kitting, and shipping fees.

Manage and audit billing data inside Extensiv (3PL Warehouse Manager) to ensure all warehouse activities are captured correctly.

Sync and maintain financial records seamlessly within QuickBooks, ensuring alignment between warehouse management data and accounting ledgers.

Research and resolve complex billing discrepancies, client disputes, and invoice adjustments.



Collections & Credit Management

Monitor aging accounts receivable reports daily to identify and target overdue balances.

Conduct strategic B2B collection outreach via phone and
 to secure past-due payments.

Assess new client credit risk and recommend appropriate credit limits or payment terms.

Establish and maintain strong, positive relationships with client accounting departments to clear payment barriers.

title: Quality Assurance Team Lead (KYC/KYB Experience)
description:
Key Responsibilities

– Build and implement the KYC/KYB QA framework, including sampling, scoring and review methodology. Design the QA framework from the ground up, a risk-weighted sampling approach (higher-risk cases reviewed more frequently than lower-risk ones), a scoring methodology that captures both document completeness and the quality of the risk judgment behind it, and a review cadence that scales as case volume grows.

– Conduct quality reviews of KYC/KYB, CDD and EDD cases, including higher-risk customers. Independently review completed onboarding files checking risk-tier accuracy, screening disposition, source of funds/wealth evidencing, and (for entity clients) whether ownership structures were properly unwrapped to identify beneficial owners. Higher-risk and EDD cases receive closer scrutiny given the greater consequence of getting them wrong.

– Identify errors, trends and root causes and recommend improvements. Go beyond flagging individual mistakes — group findings by root cause (e.g. a documentation gap vs. a genuine risk judgment error vs. a partner-specific requirement being missed) so fixes target the actual cause, whether that's a training gap, an SOP gap, or a partner requirement that isn't properly documented.

– Develop QA reporting, KPIs and management information for the Head of Compliance.

– Own a regular reporting cadence covering quality trends, recurring error types, and partner specific RFI patterns — feeding a core KPI: reducing avoidable back-and-forth with our banking partners by catching issues before submission, not after.

– Work closely with the Head of Compliance to improve processes and controls.

– Act as the operational link between the compliance policy framework and how the team actually executes day to day — flagging where documented process and real practice have drifted apart, and helping close that gap.

– Identify training needs and provide feedback to onboarding teams.

– Use QA findings to drive what training actually happens — not generic refreshers, but targeted sessions addressing the specific gaps the data is showing (e.g. a pattern of source of funds vs. source of wealth confusion, or inconsistent handling of layered ownership structures).

– Continuously improve the QA framework as the business grows.

– Evolve the framework as new banking partners, products, or entity types are added.



Qualifications

– Must have at least 3 years of QA KYC team lead experience

– Must have experience in KYC, AML, Compliance or Financial Crime QA within fintech, payments or financial services.

– Strong understanding of KYC/CDD/EDD and risk-based onboarding.

– Direct, hands-on experience assessing KYC/KYB case quality (not general customer support QA experience). This role needs someone who can independently judge whether a compliance decision was right, not just whether a process step was followed.

– Experience building a QA framework from scratch. (This is a build role, not a maintain role. The successful candidate has built up a QA function before, not just operated within an existing one

– Strong understanding of QA methodologies, scorecard design, and performance evaluation.

– Comfortable designing scoring criteria that are consistent and defensible across reviewers, and calibrating so different reviewers reach the same conclusion on the same file.

– Genuine technical depth, able to independently assess whether a risk tier was applied correctly, whether EDD was sufficient, and whether an ownership structure was properly unwrapped, not just whether a checklist was completed.

– Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations. Able to turn QA findings into practical process improvements/training

– QA findings are only useful if they change something, this role needs to turn patterns into concrete process, training, or policy recommendations, not just produce reports.

– Confident, challenging decisions and escalating issues. This role will sometimes need to tell an experienced analyst, or flag to the Head of Compliance, that something isn't good enough.

– The end output of QA work here isn't a report that sits unread — it's a training session, an SOP update, or a process fix that actually closes the gap that was found.

– Must be comfortable using their own equipment

– Must be comfortable working Dubai hours

– Must be able to commit to working exclusively with the company and not be engaged in any part-time employment

– If you’ve read carefully the entire job description, please message us your updated CV with “QA Team Lead with KYC Experience” as the message subject

title: Fact Checker (Script & Video)
description:
We make documentary-style videos that explain complex stories in a clear and engaging way for our YouTube channels:









Accuracy is central to what we do. As we scale, we're bringing on a dedicated Fact Checker to make sure everything we publish holds up to scrutiny — both what's said and what's shown.



Role Overview



You'll be responsible for verifying the accuracy of our content at two levels:



- Script fact-checking — verifying every factual claim in our scripts against reliable, credible sources before production begins.

- Video / visual fact-checking — reviewing the final cut to confirm that footage, images, maps, graphics, dates, and on-screen text actually match the script and are historically and visually accurate.



You're the last line of defence between a script and a published video, so precision and consistency matter more than speed.



What you'll actually do



- Check every factual claim in a script (names, dates, figures, events, technical/weapon/equipment details) against trustworthy primary and secondary sources.

- Flag anything unsupported, outdated, exaggerated, or incorrect, and suggest a corrected, sourced version.

- Verify visual accuracy in the edited video — that b-roll, stock footage, photos, maps, and graphics show the correct people, equipment, location, and era, with no anachronisms or mismatches to the narration.

- Provide clear, timestamped notes and source links so writers and editors can act on them without guesswork.

- Maintain a simple record of sources and verification decisions for each video.

- Communicate proactively — flag risks or unclear claims early, not after a video is scheduled.



Who we're looking for



- Meticulous and detail-obsessed. You notice the small inconsistency everyone else missed.

- A strong researcher. You know how to find reliable sources quickly and judge whether a source can be trusted.

- Comfortable verifying visuals — reverse image search, cross-referencing footage, spotting when an image or clip doesn't match the claim (OSINT-style verification is a big plus).

- Excellent written English comprehension — you can read a script closely and catch subtle inaccuracies in phrasing.

- Reliable and deadline-driven. We publish on a schedule, and verification is a fixed step in that pipeline.



Bonus points



- Genuine interest in or knowledge of military history, defense, geopolitics, or general knowledge/history topics.

- Background in journalism, research, academia, or professional fact-checking.

- Experience working with YouTube, documentary, or long-form video teams.

- Familiarity with Google Drive, Slack, and collaborative review workflows.



How to apply



Send us:

1. Your CV 

2. Answer why you are interested in position

3. A short note on your fact-checking or research experience (how this role fits your background)

4. A short answer: given a script claim like "this jet entered service in 1978," what steps would you take to confirm or correct it?



Contract & Hours



- Full-time freelance, 40 hours weekly, fully remote.

- Must follow company confidentiality, IP, and workflow policies.



Compensation



- $700 USD / month

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Facelove is a pro-age, direct-to-consumer cosmetics brand for women over 45, selling in the US, Germany and the rest of Europe. We went from zero to millions in monthly revenue in a few months.



We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to own our internal hub: keep it running, keep it secure, and build what the team needs next. Our COO built the hub with AI coding tools in eight weeks, and 60 people now run their working day on it: reports, recruitment, leave, onboarding, pay, customer support queues, order issues and finance dashboards. It has outgrown being a side job for the COO, and right now nobody else can fix it when it breaks.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You will own the hub (Next.js, Supabase, Netlify), our supply chain app, and the scheduled jobs and integrations that connect them to Slack, ClickUp, Zendesk, Shopify and our 3PL. You report to the COO and work with every department head who needs something built. You inherit a large, working codebase written fast, so the job is to make it reliable and safe without stopping it.



NOTE: This is a remote role under an independent contractor agreement. 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 18:00 CET, with a one-hour break.



Responsibilities:



Keeping it running:

• Own the uptime and correctness of the hub, the supply chain app, the Slack bot and every scheduled job, so a break is found by you, not by the team.

• Add monitoring and alerts for the things that fail quietly: webhooks that stop arriving, syncs that skip rows, jobs that never ran.

• Fix what breaks the same working day, and write down what happened and what changed.



Keeping it secure:

• Own access: sign-in, who sees what, row-level security, and removing a leaver's access everywhere on their last day.

• Keep secrets out of code, rotate them, and keep dependencies patched.

• Protect the sensitive data the hub holds: pay, invoices, candidates and personal details.



Building what comes next:

• Run the request queue: agree the week's priorities with the COO, then ship them through staging to production.

• Tell people when a request is a bad idea, and offer something better.

• Make pages people can use without asking how: a clear layout, plain labels, and screens that work on a phone.

• Build integrations and AI tooling, including MCP servers so our AI agents can read internal data directly.

• Leave every system documented and tested well enough that someone else could take it over in a week.



Non-negotiable skills:

• Three or more years building and running TypeScript web apps (React or Next.js) in production that non-technical people use every day.

• Postgres in production, including schema design, migrations written as files, and row-level security (Supabase or similar).

• Integrations that fail at 3am: webhooks, REST APIs, rate limits, retries and scheduled jobs, with a real story of one that broke.

• Security basics done properly: authentication versus authorisation, secrets kept server-side, keys rotated, dependencies patched.

• You have taken over someone else's code and made it maintainable without rewriting it for the sake of it.

• You have designed or redesigned screens that non-technical people use, and can show the before and after.

• You use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) every day, and you review what they write before it ships.

• You can explain a technical trade-off in plain written English to someone who isn't a developer.

• Facelove is your only full-time commitment, with time tracked in Hubstaff.



Nice to have:

• Next.js App Router and MUI.

• Slack API (bots, slash commands, events) and ClickUp API.

• Netlify or Vercel, scheduled functions and DNS.

• MCP server development.

• Shopify Admin API, ecommerce or supply chain systems.

• HR or finance systems that hold pay and personal data.



What success looks like:

• When something breaks, you know before the team does, and it is fixed or worked around the same working day.

• A leaver's access is gone everywhere on their last day, and no secret ever sits in code.

• What you agree on Monday is live by Friday, or you said by Wednesday that it would slip and when it will land.

• Every change reaches production through staging, with its database change in a migration file and its docs updated.

• Every request gets an answer within a working day, and the COO no longer writes code.

• People use what you ship without asking how it works, on a laptop or a phone.



WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU



We work with people for the long term, and the package is built for that.

• A competitive salary. Invoiced monthly, paid once approved

• 15 paid PTO days a year. Available after your first month, and usable as sick days

• 10 paid holidays a year. If you do not take one, it is added to your PTO credits instead

• Wellness benefit. USD 30 a month, the same in every country

• A birthday treat from us

• Free Facelove products on your 3rd month with us

• Annual team trip. A yearly all-inclusive team trip somewhere in the world, fully paid by Facelove

• USD 50 referral bonus for every person you bring in who passes probation

• A team that answers. A manager who meets you weekly and a monthly all-team town hall

We are hiring a large team of moderators to look after these campaigns: check every clip, keep out fake views and spam, and help creators do good work.

• Pay: $5 to $7 USD an hour, depending on experience.

• Fully remote. Longer-term work for people who do well.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Approve or reject drafts before they go live, for campaigns that ask for that.

• Spot fake or bought views and spam accounts, and remove creators who break the rules, so the brand is protected.

• Answer creators' questions about a campaign in a clear, kind way.

• Help find creators and pages that fit each campaign.

• Tell our team when something looks wrong, like a brief that confuses creators or a campaign running low on budget.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• You use TikTok, Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts a lot and know how short clips, captions and views work.

• Strong attention to detail.

• Fair judgment: you d
 on the rules and the evidence, not on who is asking.

• Clear written English.

• Experience in content moderation, social media, clipping, community moderation (for example 
), customer support or QA helps.

• A reliable laptop or desktop and internet connection.

• If you post clips for paid campaigns yourself, you can still apply. Tell us, so you never review your own or your friends' clips.

BEFORE YOU APPLY: STUDY CONTENT REWARDS IN DEPTH

Do not apply until you have studied Content Rewards closely. We only move forward with people who clearly understand how Content Rewards works and what it takes to moderate a campaign here.

• Go to

title: CRO & A/B Testing Specialist (E-commerce / DTC)
description:
We’re looking for an experienced CRO & A/B Testing Specialist to help us systematically improve the conversion rates of our DTC e-commerce stores.



You’ll be responsible for identifying conversion opportunities, developing testing hypotheses, launching A/B tests, analyzing results, and turning insights into actionable improvements across our landing pages, product pages, offers, bundles, and checkout funnel.



Key Responsibilities

Analyze website and funnel performance to identify conversion bottlenecks and opportunities.

Develop a structured CRO roadmap and A/B testing strategy.

Build, launch, and manage A/B tests using Intelligems or similar experimentation platforms.

Test elements such as:

Pricing and offers

Bundles and quantity breaks

Subscription vs. one-time purchase offers

Product page layouts

Headlines, copy, CTAs, and creative

Upsells and cross-sells

Landing page structures

Determine appropriate test duration, sample size, and statistical significance.

Analyze test results beyond just CVR, including AOV, RPV, revenue, subscription take rate, and profitability.

Document learnings and recommend which winning tests should be rolled out.

Work closely with our media buying, creative, and development teams.

Continuously develop new testing hypotheses based on customer behavior and performance data.



Requirements

Proven experience in CRO and A/B testing for DTC/e-commerce brands.

Hands-on experience with Intelligems or similar tools.

Strong understanding of Shopify conversion funnels.

Experience testing pricing, bundles, subscriptions, PDPs, and landing pages.

Strong analytical skills and understanding of statistical significance.

Comfortable interpreting data and translating it into clear actions.

Able to show examples of previous tests and measurable improvements.



To apply, please send us your portfolio so we can see your previous work, let us know the tools you used for testing, and let us know your rate.

title: SEO & GEO Growth Specialist – Long-Term
description:
1. About Us

We are a China-based manufacturing company providing CNC machining and a wide range of custom manufacturing services to international B2B customers.

We are looking for a self-driven SEO & GEO specialist to help us grow our online presence, attract international customers, and generate qualified business inquiries through Google, Bing, and AI-powered search platforms.

The manufacturing industry has a broad customer base and significant search demand, offering plenty of opportunities for organic growth.

This is our first project together. If we establish a successful working relationship and achieve good results, there will be more websites and projects to work on in the future.

We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us over the long term.

2. Main Responsibilities

WordPress Publishing & Management

• Publish and manage website content using WordPress and the Avada theme.

• Format pages, upload images, create tables, and manage internal links.

• Ensure all published content is properly structured and displayed.



SEO Strategy & Keyword Planning

• Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis.

• Identify high-intent keywords and business opportunities.

• Develop content strategies, keyword clusters, and website architecture.

Website Content Production

• Research and create high-quality, SEO-friendly technical content.

• Develop service pages, industry pages, technical guides, and supporting articles.

• Create content based on customer questions, search intent, and industry research.

On-Page SEO & Technical QA

• Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal links, and schema markup.

• Identify technical SEO issues and ensure content meets SEO quality standards.

Link Building & Outreach

• Find relevant websites and backlink opportunities.

• Conduct guest posting and editorial outreach.

• Build relationships with industry-related websites, manufacturers, suppliers, and technical publications.

• Acquire relevant contextual backlinks through genuine content contributions.

GEO & AI Search Optimization

• Improve brand visibility across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and other AI-powered search platforms.

• Optimize content to increase AI citations, brand mentions, and recommendations.

• Develop strategies to improve visibility in AI-driven supplier discovery.

Content Distribution & Community Engagement

• Research relevant discussions and customer questions on Reddit and Quora.

• Provide helpful, knowledgeable answers to industry-related questions.

• Publish and distribute technical content through Medium and Substack.

• Build brand authority without spam or aggressive promotion.

SEO Performance & Data Analysis

• Monitor website performance through Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools.

• Analyze rankings, organic traffic, impressions, clicks, and CTR.

• Identify opportunities for content updates and new pages based on actual search data.

• Continuously improve SEO performance and lead generation.

3. What We Are Looking For

This section is particularly important. Please read it carefully before applying.

We are looking for someone who:

• Wants a long-term working relationship: We are not looking for someone interested in only a short-term freelance project.

• Is highly self-motivated: You can organize your own work, identify opportunities, and take action without waiting for daily instructions.

• Works independently: You can manage tasks, solve problems, and continuously improve your work without constant supervision.

• Has a results-oriented mindset: You understand that the ultimate goal is to generate qualified B2B inquiries, not simply increase website traffic.

• Is willing to learn: You are interested in understanding manufacturing processes, engineering terminology, industrial products, and B2B customer requirements.

• Can use AI tools effectively: You know how to use ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools to improve research, content production, analysis, and productivity.

• Is responsible and consistent: You can maintain a stable working routine and provide regular progress reports.

You do not need to be an expert in every area from day one. However, a strong learning attitude, initiative, and willingness to take ownership are essential.

4. Compensation & Unlimited Performance Commission

• Base Pay: $3 per hour

• Commission: $6 for every qualified inquiry

We believe the manufacturing industry offers significant opportunities to generate qualified B2B inquiries through SEO, content marketing, link building, and AI search optimization.

Our initial baseline target is 5 qualified inquiries per day as the project develops.

Example of Monthly Earnings

Based on 8 working hours per day and 22 working days per month:

Income Component Calculation Monthly Earnings

Hourly Pay 8 × 22 × $3 $528

Inquiry Commission 5 × 22 × $6 $660

Total  $1,188

And this is just the baseline example based on 5 qualified inquiries per day.

There is absolutely no upper limit on the number of inquiries that can earn commissions.

If you generate 8, 10, 15, or more qualified inquiries per day, you will receive commission for every additional qualified inquiry.

The more qualified inquiries you generate, the more you earn. 

A qualified inquiry must come from a genuine potential customer with a relevant manufacturing or purchasing requirement and valid contact information. Spam, duplicate, irrelevant, and non-business inquiries do not qualify.

5. Long-Term Growth Opportunities

This is our first project, but we have plans to develop additional websites and expand our digital marketing activities.

If you perform well and we establish a successful working relationship, you will have opportunities to:

• Take responsibility for additional websites and SEO projects.

• Develop and manage broader SEO and GEO strategies.

• Take on more responsibilities and grow professionally.

• Increase your overall earnings through additional projects and performance incentives.

We prefer to invest in someone who wants to grow with the business rather than repeatedly hire and train short-term freelancers.

6. Before Applying

Please make sure the following points describe you:

1. You are genuinely interested in a stable, long-term working relationship.

2. You are self-driven and comfortable working independently.

3. You are willing to learn about the manufacturing industry and develop your skills.

4. You are motivated to improve results and increase your earnings over time.

Application Questions:

1. Are you looking for a long-term position or a short-term freelance project? Why?

2. What experience do you have with SEO, WordPress, GEO, or AI tools? Please share examples of your previous work if available.

If you are looking for a long-term opportunity where you can take ownership, develop your skills, and earn more based on your results, we would like to hear from you.



To confirm that you have carefully read the entire job description, please start your application with the following exact sentence:

"I have read the entire job description, understand the compensation structure, and am genuinely interested in a long-term working relationship."



Additional Requirements

• Strong English reading and writing skills are essential.

• Must have a reliable computer and stable internet connection.

• Experience with SEO and WordPress is preferred.

• Familiarity with Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, Semrush, or similar tools is an advantage.

• Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude.

• Able to work independently, organize daily tasks, and provide weekly progress reports.

• Willing to treat this position as a primary long-term work commitment.

• Willing to continuously learn about manufacturing, engineering, and international B2B marketing.

title: Telephone Assistant — Part-Time, Work From Home
description:
4X Medical Recruiters · Remote · Part-time, 4 days a week (Monday to Thursday), 4 hours a day, 16 hours a week · Start 10 December 2026



About us

4X Medical Recruiters is a growing Australian recruitment business that helps GPs (family doctors) from the UK, Australia and around the world find their next role in Australian clinics. We're a young, ambitious startup, and we're looking for a friendly voice to be the first point of contact for the doctors we work with.



About the role

You'll call doctors who have shown interest in working in Australia, follow up with them in a warm and professional way, answer their first questions, and arrange interview calls for them with our recruitment consultants. You'll work from a daily call sheet we prepare for you, with scripts and background notes on each person, so you'll always know who to call and why.

You'll also be our first point of contact for any new incoming calls during Australian business hours (9am – 5pm Sydney, which is 6am – 2pm Manila), including outside your shifts. These calls are rare, just a few a week, and short. You're paid per call on top of your monthly rate.

When calls finish early, you'll help with light online research and admin, such as checking clinic details on websites and Google.



Why this role builds gradually

As a startup, our call volume starts small and grows as our business grows. Your first month is focused on training, preparation and online research. From mid-January the role moves more and more towards phone calls. Your hours and pay stay the same throughout, and you'll grow with us.

Schedule (Manila time)

Monday: 10am – 2pm

Tuesday: 7pm – 11pm

Wednesday: 10am – 2pm

Thursday: 7pm – 11pm

The split between daytime and evening shifts lets you reach doctors in Australia and in the UK at good times for them. Fridays and weekends are off, apart from optional interviews.

Thursday: the evening shift (7pm – 11pm), as planned. On rare occasions, depending on how call volume builds, we might flip it to the daytime shift (10am – 2pm), always agreed well in advance.



Pay

• ₱21,500 a month (about ₱310 an hour), guaranteed for 4 hours a day, 4 days a week

• Extra pay per call for answering new incoming calls during Australian business hours (a few a week, 2–5 minutes each): ₱100 per call

• This is an independent contractor role: you send a simple monthly invoice and look after your own local tax and registration

• Interview attendance: join our candidate interviews on video as a second team member, 30 minutes each: ₱175 per interview, flat rate on any day.



What we're looking for

• Excellent spoken English: clear, confident and natural on the phone

• Warm, positive and full of energy, with a genuine liking for talking to people

• A smart, quick and keen learner: you'll pick up how GP recruitment and our business work, so you can answer common questions with confidence, and when you don't know the answer, handle it gracefully and pass it on to the right person

• Reliable and organised: you show up on time and keep good notes

• A quiet place to work, a laptop or computer, stable internet, and a working webcam with a neat background for video calls

• No previous experience needed. We'll train you fully.



What we provide

• Full training, call scripts and an FAQ guide

• Phone system (app on your laptop and mobile)

• A daily call sheet with everything you need for each call

• A supportive team and a chance to grow with a new business



How to apply

Please send:

1.  A short introduction about yourself

2.  A 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself in English, as if you were calling a doctor for the first time

3.  Confirmation that you can work the schedule above



Shortlisted applicants will be asked for ID verification on a video call, a current NBI clearance and two references, and will complete a paid trial shift before starting.

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a short practice call. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Amazon Fba product sourcer (Online arbitrage, Wholesale arbitrage)
description:
Looking for an experienced Amazon FBA sourcer to find profitable online 

arbitrage leads for our store. Must already be comfortable with SellerAmp 

and Keepa — this is not an entry-level/training role.



Hours: 25 hours/week required

Pay: Flat weekly rate (based on experience — mention your rate expectations 

when applying)

Quota: Minimum 5-10 vetted leads per day, logged in our shared Google Sheet

Reporting: Google Sheet must be updated daily — no batching leads to dump 

at the end of the week

Performance: Repeated missed quotas or unreported days will result in a 

warning, then pay adjustment, then termination if it continues



What you'll do:

- Reverse source: go through other sellers' storefronts on Amazon to find 

 what they're selling, then locate that same product cheaper from the 

 retailer/website they likely sourced it from

- Vet every lead using Keepa (price history, sales rank history, seller 

 count over time) and SellerAmp (ROI, fees, profitability, eligibility)

- Check BSR (Best Seller Rank) against category requirements to confirm 

 it's a fast enough mover before submitting a lead

- Confirm eligibility/ungating status on each ASIN before adding it to 

 the list — don't submit gated items unless already approved

- Flag any IP complaint risk, hazmat, or restricted brand issues

- Update the shared Google Sheet daily with: product name, buy link, cost, 

 sell price, ROI %, BSR, and eligibility status for every lead found

- OFFER COUNT MUST BE LOW



What you need to already know:

-We are gated on lots of products due to us being a new seller

- SellerAmp (SAS) — pulling ROI/profitability and running eligibility checks

- Keepa — reading price/rank history charts, spotting stable vs. volatile 

 listings

- Reverse sourcing / storefront stalking methodology

- What BSR ranges are actually sourceable per category (not just "low 

 number = good")

- Amazon's restricted categories, gated brands, and common IP-risk red 

 flags



Access provided:

- Your own restricted Seller Central login (Inventory access only — no 

 orders, payments, or financial data)

- Shared SellerAmp login for research

- Shared Google Sheet for daily lead logging

- You will connect YOUR OWN Seller Central login inside SellerAmp when 

 prompted — do not use any other login



To apply: send 2-3 sample leads with your reasoning (Keepa chart read, 

ROI calc, why you picked it). Shortlisted applicants will hop on a call 

to be interviewed before final hire.
