title: Shopify eCommerce Growth & Development Manager | Hands-On Store Ownership | Remote
description:
**Job Type:** Part-time initially, with potential for long-term growth\

**Location:** Remote\

**Industry:** Australian eCommerce / Online Retail



## About the Role



We are an Australian company managing and developing multiple eCommerce brands. We are looking for an experienced, hands-on **Shopify eCommerce Growth & Development Manager** who can take ownership of developing, improving, and growing our online stores.



**This is NOT a routine Shopify Store Administrator, Product Listing VA, or Order Management position.**



We need someone who understands how to build and develop an eCommerce business, not simply maintain its daily operations.



Your main responsibility will be to identify opportunities, plan improvements, and personally implement changes that enhance our Shopify stores, improve the customer journey, increase conversions, and support sustainable business growth.



You should be comfortable working both strategically and practically. We are not looking for someone who only prepares plans and delegates tasks. You must be capable of executing a significant portion of the work yourself.



Initially, the role will focus heavily on Shopify website development, store improvements, and conversion optimisation. Over time, responsibilities may expand into social media, digital marketing, brand development, and other growth initiatives.



## Key Responsibilities



**1. Shopify Store Development & Improvement (Primary Focus)**



- Take ownership of ongoing Shopify store development and improvement projects.

- Review existing stores, identify weaknesses, and recommend practical solutions.

- Improve homepage layouts, product pages, collections, navigation, menus, and overall website structure.

- Implement Shopify theme customisations, app configurations, and website enhancements.

- Develop new landing pages, promotional pages, product launches, and conversion-focused content.

- Coordinate with developers or designers for more technical tasks when required.



**2. Customer Journey & Conversion Optimisation**



- Analyse the complete customer journey, from first website visit through checkout.

- Identify friction points affecting customer experience, trust, and purchasing decisions.

- Improve product presentation, calls to action, mobile experience, and checkout flow.

- Recommend and implement improvements to increase conversion rates and average order value.

- Review competitor websites and introduce relevant improvements and best practices.

- Use Shopify Analytics, GA4, heatmaps, and other tools to identify improvement opportunities.



**3. eCommerce Business Development & Growth**



- Develop practical action plans for improving online store performance and sales.

- Identify opportunities for new products, bundles, promotions, upselling, and cross-selling.

- Support new brand launches and the development of new Shopify stores.

- Coordinate projects from initial concept through implementation and performance review.

- Monitor store performance, evaluate results, and continuously recommend improvements.



**4. Marketing & Brand Development (Secondary / Future Focus)**



- Support social media strategy, content planning, and brand development.

- Coordinate with designers, content creators, influencers, and marketing specialists.

- Assist with
 marketing, SEO, promotional campaigns, and customer retention initiatives.

- Identify opportunities to improve brand visibility, engagement, and customer acquisition.



## Mandatory Requirements



- Minimum **3 years of relevant hands-on Shopify and eCommerce development experience**.

- Demonstrated experience improving or developing Shopify stores, not just managing daily operations.

- Strong understanding of website UX, customer journey, conversion optimisation, and online sales.

- Ability to implement Shopify improvements independently, including themes, apps, pages, and store configurations.

- Proven experience taking ownership of projects from planning through execution.

- Ability to analyse problems, propose solutions, and implement improvements without constant instructions.

- Experience working with Australian eCommerce businesses.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong organisational skills, initiative, accountability, and attention to detail.



**Highly Regarded**



- Experience managing multiple eCommerce brands or working in an eCommerce agency.

- Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS, or other relevant technical skills.

- Shopify SEO, Google Analytics 4, Google Merchant Center, and conversion tracking.

- Klaviyo,
 marketing, and customer retention strategies.

- Social media strategy and content development.

- Experience launching new online stores or developing brands from scratch.



## Who Should Apply?



We are particularly interested in candidates who can confidently say:



- I have personally built, developed, or significantly improved Shopify stores.

- I understand what makes customers trust a website and complete a purchase.

- I can independently identify problems and implement practical improvements.

- I can manage projects and deliver measurable outcomes, not just complete assigned tasks.

- I understand how different elements of an eCommerce business work together to generate sales.



**Please do not apply if your experience is primarily limited to product uploads, order processing, inventory updates, customer service, or routine store administration.**



## Mandatory Self-Assessment



Please rate your skills in each area using **None / Basic / Professional**.



1. Shopify store setup and development

2. Shopify theme customisation and editing

3. Shopify apps and integrations

4. Website UX and customer journey improvement

5. Conversion rate optimisation (CRO)

6. Product page and landing page development

7. Shopify store audits and performance improvement

8. Shopify Analytics and Google Analytics 4

9. eCommerce business growth strategy

10. Product launches, bundles, upselling, and promotions

11. Shopify SEO and website content optimisation

12. Shopify Liquid / HTML / CSS

13. eCommerce project management and ownership

14. Competitor research and market analysis

15. Klaviyo and
 marketing

16. Social media strategy and content development

17. Coordination of designers, developers, and marketers

18. Experience supporting Australian eCommerce businesses



## How to Apply



Please submit:



**1. Resume and relevant experience**



Include your years of Shopify experience and details of Australian eCommerce businesses you have supported.



**2. Shopify Portfolio – Mandatory**



Provide links to at least **three Shopify stores** you have personally developed, significantly improved, or managed through major enhancement projects.



For each store, briefly explain:



- What was the situation or problem?

- What improvements did you personally implement?

- What results did you achieve?



**3. Introduction Video – Maximum 3 Minutes**



Record a short video explaining:



- Your relevant Shopify and eCommerce development experience.

- One or two significant Shopify projects you personally delivered.

- How you approach improving an existing Shopify store.

- Why you believe you are suitable for this ownership-focused role.



Upload your video to Loom, Google Drive, or a similar platform and provide a link accessible without requesting permission or entering a password.



**4. Completed Self-Assessment**



Use the checklist above.



**5. Expected Hourly Rate and Availability**



Provide your expected hourly rate in AUD and weekly availability.



## Important Application Notes



Applications without the required **portfolio, introduction video, and completed self-assessment** will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will be asked to demonstrate previous Shopify projects during an interview, explain the changes they personally implemented, and discuss the outcomes achieved.



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term contributor to the development and growth of our eCommerce businesses, not simply another person completing routine administrative tasks.

title: Medical Virtual Assistant
description:
• Pay: USD 750 a month base, plus performance incentives with no cap. Our top performers take home USD 1,300 to 1,500 a month.

• Shift: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern (10 PM to 7 AM in Manila), with some weekend shifts for coverage

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

• Where: fully remote, from a quiet room at home



A CALL, FOR EXAMPLE

Your first call of the day is to a woman in her seventies with COPD. Her health system referred her to us last week. She asks how you got her number. You explain who we are and how our team can help her stay well at home, answer her questions, and book her first visit.



THE JOB

Health systems across the US refer older patients with heart failure or COPD to us, often after a hospital stay. You call them, explain in plain words how our doctors, nurses and respiratory therapists can care for them at home, and book their first video visit.



You make 45 to 60 calls a day. Most go to voicemail, and about a dozen become real conversations. Some patients are wary, some are tired of doctors, some just want someone to listen. Your job is to help each one decide whether to join, and to get them to a first visit within a week or so. Between calls you schedule visits, keep patient records up to date and work with our clinical team.



WHAT YOU NEED



• 2 or more years on the phone in customer service or healthcare

• Comfort with clinical topics: nursing or other clinical training, or healthcare work where you talked with patients about their conditions

• Clear spoken English that a US patient understands the first time

• A quiet room, internet of 30 Mbps or faster, and a backup for outages

• Availability for this shift for the long term

A healthcare degree, US healthcare accounts, sales or appointment-setting experience, or Spanish are a plus.



This is a phone job with daily targets, not back-office or email work. If you like talking with people and helping them say yes to care, you will do well here.



HOW TO APPLY (ABOUT 15 MINUTES)



1. Apply only at https://www.ansiblehealth.com/careers/jobs/onboarding-specialist-csr-3b2bb7f5/apply?ref=natn5fw9 . Applications sent any other way are not reviewed.

2. Answer a few quick questions. When the form asks for the word from this posting, type LUNGS.

3. Record your voice on the form: read three lines from a real call, then answer a patient in your own words (about five minutes).

4. Give your earliest start date and the notice you owe your current employer.

If you are shortlisted, we email you a link to book a 15-minute call with our recruiter.

**Hourly Rate:** USD $4.37/hour  

**Content Volume:** 6–7 videos per week (approximately 1 video daily)  

**Platforms:** Instagram Reels, TikTok & YouTube Shorts  

**Video Length:** 15–45 seconds per video  

**Format:** Vertical 9:16 (1080 × 1920)



### Job Overview



I am looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and reliable short-form video editor/content creator to produce engaging, informative, and professional faceless videos focused on Dubai's real estate market, property transactions, regulations, and administrative processes.



The goal is to simplify complex real estate topics into easy-to-understand, visually engaging videos that capture viewers' attention within the first few seconds.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who can consistently deliver high-quality educational content while maintaining a recognizable and cohesive visual style across all platforms.



### Key Responsibilities



- Create 6–7 short-form videos weekly, ready for daily publishing.

- Research relevant Dubai real estate topics, including DLD, RERA, Ejari, Oqood, property transactions, developer processes, and market updates.

- Develop concise, accurate, engaging scripts with strong opening hooks.

- Produce faceless videos using professional motion graphics, animations, relevant property footage, and visual storytelling.

- Include clear English AI voiceovers with natural pronunciation and engaging delivery.

- Add accurate, synchronized subtitles and minimal, readable on-screen text.

- Maintain consistent branding, typography, colors, and editing styles.

- Optimize each video for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

- Suggest relevant content ideas and trends that appeal to investors, property owners, tenants, agents, and real estate professionals.

- Deliver completed videos with suggested captions, titles, and relevant hashtags.



### Content Focus



Videos should cover educational and informative topics such as:



- Dubai real estate market insights and updates

- Buying, selling, and renting properties in Dubai

- DLD and RERA regulations and procedures

- Ejari registration, renewals, and tenancy processes

- Oqood registration and off-plan property transactions

- Developer registrations, escrow accounts, and property handovers

- Common property transaction mistakes and useful tips

- Real estate terminology explained in simple language



### Video Style & Requirements



- Modern, clean, professional, and visually appealing.

- Faceless content — no on-camera presenter required.

- Strong opening hook within the first 2–3 seconds.

- Fast-paced but easy-to-follow editing.

- Clear and natural-sounding English voiceover.

- Accurate subtitles without spelling errors or unnecessary text.

- Informative, practical, and straightforward storytelling.

- Consistent branding across every video.

- No repetitive footage, distorted AI graphics, or inaccurate information.

- Royalty-free or properly licensed visuals and audio.



### Qualifications



- Experience creating Instagram Reels, TikTok videos, or YouTube Shorts.

- Strong video editing and visual storytelling skills.

- Ability to research and simplify technical information.

- Excellent English writing, grammar, and attention to detail.

- Familiarity with Dubai real estate is an advantage, but not mandatory.

- Ability to work independently and consistently meet weekly deadlines.



### Compensation



**USD $4.37 per hour**, with a potential long-term working arrangement based on performance, consistency, and content quality.



### How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Examples of faceless educational or informative short-form videos you have created.

IG account for

title: Short-Form Video Asset Manager / B-Roll Creator (iPhone Required)
description:
I'm looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Short-Form Video Asset Manager / B-Roll Creator to help with my daily content production workflow.



This is not a full video editing role. Your main responsibilities will be reviewing reference videos, finding and organizing the visual assets and background music needed for each video, and filming original B-roll footage using your iPhone.



We create short-form videos promoting different apps, websites, AI tools, and software products.



You will receive reference videos that demonstrate the types of assets, music, and B-roll footage needed. Your job is to gather those materials and recreate the necessary B-roll so our editors have everything they need to assemble the final videos.



An iPhone is required for this position. You will use your iPhone's camera to physically film your computer screen while demonstrating websites, apps, and software tools.



For example, if a reference video shows ChatGPT generating a response, you may need to open ChatGPT on your computer, recreate a similar demonstration, and film your computer monitor using your iPhone.



IMPORTANT: You will NEVER be required to show your face or film yourself.



All B-roll will focus on your computer screen, software interfaces, and the actions taking place on the screen. Occasionally, a shot may include your hand pointing at the monitor or interacting with the computer, but your face and body will not appear.



You will also not need to speak, record voiceovers, or appear on camera.



The footage will be used underneath voiceovers that are handled separately.



We are looking for someone who can independently prepare complete asset packages so our editors can focus on editing rather than searching for materials.



RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Visual Asset Research, Music, and Collection



Carefully review the reference videos provided and identify the visual and audio assets needed.



These may include:



Video overlays



Existing B-roll clips



Screenshots



Images



Logos



Graphics



Social media clips



Website screenshots



App interfaces



Background music used in reference videos



Similar background music matching the reference video's style, tone, and pacing



Other visual or audio elements shown in the reference video



You will be responsible for finding and downloading the correct or closely matching assets.



Background music is an important part of this role.



You should attempt to identify the music used in the reference video whenever possible. If the original track cannot be identified or legally used, find a suitable licensed or royalty-free alternative that matches the reference video's overall feel.



Only source music and assets that can be used with the necessary permissions or licenses.



The goal is to provide our editors with all the visual assets and music they need without having to find these materials themselves.



2. Original B-Roll Filming Using an iPhone



In addition to gathering existing assets, you will be responsible for filming original B-roll using your iPhone camera.



This does NOT involve filming yourself, showing your face, speaking, or recording yourself on camera.



Most B-roll will involve pointing your iPhone camera at your computer monitor while demonstrating websites, software, or AI tools.



The purpose is to capture authentic, high-quality footage of computer screens that our editors can use in short-form videos.



Examples of B-roll include:



Filming your computer monitor while ChatGPT, Claude, or another AI tool is being used.



Capturing prompts being typed into AI applications.



Filming AI-generated responses appearing on the screen.



Capturing website navigation and scrolling.



Showing software features, menus, and dashboards.



Filming mouse movements and clicks within an application.



Demonstrating how a website or software feature works.



Recreating computer-screen visuals shown in reference videos.



Occasionally including a hand pointing toward something on the monitor, when appropriate.



For example, if the reference video shows someone entering a prompt into an AI tool and displaying the results, your task would be to recreate that demonstration on your computer and film the screen using your iPhone.



You are filming the computer screen and what's happening on it—not yourself.



Important filming requirements



An iPhone with a good-quality camera is required.



All footage should primarily focus on the computer screen.



Your face must not appear in the footage.



You will not be required to film yourself or your body.



An occasional hand pointing at the screen is acceptable when needed.



No talking or voiceover recording is required.



No full video editing is required.



Film using your iPhone's camera rather than OBS or computer screen-recording software.



Footage should be clear, stable, and properly focused.



Avoid glare, reflections, flickering, and blurry footage.



Make sure text and important information on the computer screen are readable.



Record vertically (9:16) unless otherwise instructed.



Upload original, high-quality video files without unnecessary compression.



Do not display personal information, passwords, or private accounts in the footage.



I will provide reference examples, instructions, and guidance on how to film the necessary B-roll.



You do not need prior professional filming experience, but you should be comfortable learning how to capture clean footage of a computer monitor.



3. Google Drive Asset Organization



Once all assets, background music, and B-roll footage have been collected, you will:



Upload everything into the correct Google Drive asset folder.



Organize B-roll recordings, overlays, screenshots, images, music, and other materials.



Use clear filenames so the editor can easily identify each file.



Ensure all necessary assets are included.



Confirm that B-roll recordings are clear and usable.



Include the appropriate background music or an approved alternative.



Update our Google Sheets production board when the asset package is complete.



Each assignment should result in a complete, organized asset package that the editor can use immediately.



4. Communication and Coordination



You will also be expected to:



Communicate with our video editors when necessary.



Respond when an editor needs an additional asset, music track, or B-roll clip.



Fix missing or incorrect materials promptly.



Use 
 for team communication.



Follow assigned deadlines.



Complete your daily assignments without constant supervision.



Communicate clearly if you encounter any issues.



WORKLOAD AND SCHEDULE



This is a long-term, part-time position requiring consistent availability Monday through Sunday.



You will be expected to complete a minimum target of 5–6 video asset packages per day.



Each package includes the applicable:



Visual overlays



Screenshots and images



Background music



Existing B-roll assets



Original iPhone-filmed B-roll footage



Other necessary reference materials



Some videos may require more B-roll filming or additional research than others.



The workload will vary depending on the complexity of the reference videos and the amount of material needed.



You must be able to work efficiently, manage multiple assignments, and complete your work early enough for our editors to begin editing.



We use Google Drive, Google Sheets, and 
 to organize assignments and communicate with the team.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



The ideal candidate is:



Reliable and consistent.



Very detail-oriented.



Good at online research and finding visual assets.



Comfortable filming computer screens using an iPhone.



Familiar with AI tools, websites, and software applications.



Able to recreate software demonstrations shown in reference videos.



Familiar with finding and matching background music.



Comfortable using Google Drive and Google Sheets.



Familiar with TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and short-form video content.



Comfortable using 
.



Organized and able to manage multiple assignments.



Able to communicate clearly with editors.



Willing to learn new tools and filming techniques.



Able to work independently.



Consistently available, including weekends.



Experience with short-form video editing is helpful but not required.



You do not need to edit the final videos. Our video editors handle the editing.



EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS



An iPhone is REQUIRED for this position.



Applicants must have:



An iPhone with a good-quality, functioning camera.



A reliable computer or laptop with a clear display.



Reliable internet access.



Enough phone and computer storage to manage video files.



The ability to transfer recorded iPhone videos to Google Drive.



Access to Google Sheets, Google Drive, and 
.



An Apple/Mac computer is strongly preferred but not required.



You should be able to open websites and use software on your computer while filming the monitor with your iPhone.



A phone tripod or stand is helpful for steady footage but is not required.



You do not need OBS, QuickTime screen-recording software, or professional camera equipment.



PAY



$2 USD per completed video asset package.



You will be assigned a daily target of approximately 5–6 videos.



Each completed package must include all required assets, background music, and original B-roll footage, organized inside the correct Google Drive folder.



Example earnings (assuming 30 working days):



5 videos/day = $10/day = $300/month



6 videos/day = $12/day = $360/month



These are estimated earnings based on completed and accepted assignments, not a fixed monthly salary or guaranteed number of assignments.



Payment details and frequency will be discussed during onboarding.



This is intended to be a long-term opportunity, with potential increases in compensation and responsibilities based on performance, reliability, and workload.



PORTFOLIO / WORK SAMPLES



If you have relevant work samples, please include them.



Examples include:



Videos of computer monitors filmed using an iPhone.



Footage showing websites or AI tools being demonstrated on a computer screen.



Short-form videos where you helped gather B-roll and overlays.



Examples of visual assets or background music you sourced.



Organized Google Drive asset folders.



Content research or social media research.



Examples showing your ability to recreate a reference video's visuals.



A traditional video editing portfolio is not required.



I'm particularly interested in seeing whether you can film clear computer-screen B-roll using your iPhone, identify the assets needed for a video, and organize everything for an editor.



If you don't have relevant samples, briefly explain any similar experience.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following in your application:



A short introduction about yourself.



Your experience finding B-roll, overlays, screenshots, music, and other video assets.



Your experience filming computer screens or software demonstrations with a phone camera.



Your experience identifying or sourcing background music.



Your iPhone model.



Whether you use a Mac or Windows computer.



Any relevant portfolio or work samples.



Your typical daily availability, including weekends.



Your experience using Google Drive and Google Sheets.



Your experience using 
.



Whether you're comfortable completing at least 5–6 asset packages daily.



Please include the word PINEAPPLE somewhere in your application so I know you've read the entire job description.



Applications that do not include the keyword may not be considered.

title: Affiliate Marketing Specialist
description:
Full Time - Must map to US working hours.



About Salame Lash Artistry



Salame Lash Artistry a eyelash brand focused on high performing lash supplies for diy enthusiast and pro lash techs. 



We are building a creator-led marketing program across Instagram and TikTok and are looking for a highly organized, persistent, and resourceful person to help us identify creators, manage outreach, coordinate product seeding, and build a consistent pipeline of authentic video content.



This is not a general social media posting role.



Your primary responsibility will be to help us find the right creators and turn those relationships into high-quality videos that can be tested through paid advertising.



The Role



You will spend a significant portion of each day researching creators on Instagram and TikTok who are a strong fit for our brand.



You will then organize them, evaluate their content, reach out to them, follow up, coordinate product shipments, track communication, and help move each creator from initial discovery through completed content and advertising permissions.



Our goal is to build a large and continuously growing library of authentic creator videos that can be tested across Meta, Instagram, TikTok, Amazon, and other marketing channels.



Primary Responsibilities



Creator Research and Sourcing



* Research Instagram and TikTok creators every day

* Identify creators in clean beauty, hair care, wellness, non-toxic living, fitness, motherhood, lifestyle, and related niches

* Find micro-creators, small and mid sized creators

* Review creator content for authenticity, communication style, video quality, audience alignment, and advertising potential

* Identify creators who are comfortable speaking on camera and demonstrating products

* Build and maintain a large, organized creator database

* Avoid duplicate outreach and keep creator records accurate



Creator Evaluation



For each creator, evaluate and record:



* Name

* Instagram and TikTok handles

* Platform links

* Follower count

* Estimated engagement

* Primary niche

* Audience profile

* Location

* Content style

* Video quality

* On-camera communication

* Brand fit

* Past beauty or wellness collaborations

* Contact information

* Why the creator may be a strong fit

* Potential content angle

* Outreach status



Outreach and Follow-Up



* Send personalized outreach messages by
, Instagram, and TikTok

* Avoid generic mass outreach

* Explain why each creator is relevant to the brand

* Follow up consistently and professionally

* Respond to creator questions

* Track negotiations and creator expectations

* Schedule calls when necessary

* Maintain accurate records of every interaction



Product Seeding and Content Coordination



* Collect shipping details

* Coordinate product shipments with the operations team

* Track delivery

* Follow up after product delivery

* Confirm which products and content concepts the creator will test

* Help prepare creative briefs and talking points

* Track expected delivery dates for content

* Follow up until content is received

* Organize completed videos and raw files



Whitelisting and Advertising Permissions



* Ask creators for permission to use their content in paid advertising

* Help coordinate Meta Partnership Ads, Instagram permissions, TikTok Spark Ads, and other whitelisting processes

* Maintain records of usage rights and agreed terms

* Confirm whether content can be edited, resized, and used across multiple channels

* Coordinate with the Founder and marketing team when content is ready for testing



Reporting and Organization



* Maintain a clean creator pipeline in Notion, or another approved system

* Provide daily and weekly progress updates

* Report outreach volume, replies, interested creators, products shipped, content received, and permissions secured

* Identify bottlenecks and recommend process improvements

* Create and improve SOPs for creator sourcing, outreach, follow-up, and content tracking



What Success Looks Like



The successful person in this role will consistently:



* Find high-quality, relevant creators

* Send thoughtful and personalized outreach

* Follow up without needing reminders

* Keep the creator pipeline extremely organized

* Move creators from initial contact to completed content

* Build strong and respectful creator relationships

* Help us create a growing library of authentic videos

* Improve the process over time using AI, templates, and systems



Initial Performance Expectations



During the first 30–60 days, we expect you to build a repeatable creator sourcing and outreach system.



Potential activity targets may include:



* Researching and evaluating 30–50 relevant creators per day

* Sending 15–30 personalized outreach messages per day

* Completing consistent follow-ups

* Maintaining accurate pipeline records

* Securing a growing number of interested creators each week

* Helping move creators toward product trials, completed videos, and paid advertising permissions



Quality is more important than sending large volumes of generic messages.



Required Qualifications



* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong internet research skills

* Highly organized and detail-oriented

* Comfortable spending several hours each day researching creators

* Strong follow-up discipline

* Professional and friendly communication

* Comfortable using Instagram and TikTok

* Strong Google Sheets skills

* Comfortable learning new software and systems

* Ability to work independently and manage repetitive workflows accurately

* Willingness to work U.S. business hours

* Reliable internet and computer



referred Experience



Experience in one or more of the following is helpful:



* Influencer marketing

* Creator sourcing

* Influencer outreach

* Affiliate marketing

* Social media research

* UGC coordination

* Beauty, wellness, hair care, or consumer products

* Meta Partnership Ads

* Instagram whitelisting

* TikTok Spark Ads

* Creator databases or CRM systems



Prior experience is helpful, but intelligence, persistence, organization, communication, and willingness to learn are equally important.



## AI and Workflow Expectations



You should be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to:



* Research creators

* Improve outreach messages

* Personalize communication

* Summarize creator profiles

* Generate content-angle ideas

* Organize information

* Improve follow-up systems

* Create SOPs and workflow efficiencies



AI should improve the quality and speed of your work, not produce generic or impersonal outreach.



## Who You Are



You may be a strong fit if:



* You enjoy research and finding people online

* You are naturally persistent

* You do not give up after one unanswered message

* You are highly organized

* You enjoy communicating with creators

* You notice quality and authenticity in videos

* You can follow a detailed process consistently

* You take ownership without waiting for constant instructions

* You are interested in building something long-term



## To Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your resume

2. A short introduction explaining why this role interests you

3. Any relevant influencer, outreach, research, social media, or creator-management experience





Please also complete the short application exercise below.



Application Exercise



Part 1 — Creator Research



Find 10 Instagram or TikTok creators who you believe would be a strong fit for Salame Lash Artistry



Please include:



* Creator name

* Instagram or TikTok handle

* Platform link

* Follower count

* Content niche

* Why you selected them

* One content angle you believe they could create for the brand

* Whether you believe they would be a strong candidate for paid advertising and why



Please DO NOT select celebrities or very large creators. Focus will be on micro, small and mid-size creators.



Part 2 — Outreach



Write one personalized outreach message to one of the creators you selected.



The message should:



* Reference something specific about the creator

* Explain why the creator fits the brand

* Invite them to try the products

* Sound warm and human

* Avoid sounding like a mass template



Part 3 — Organization



Create a simple spreadsheet showing how you would track:



* Creator researched

* Outreach sent

* Follow-up dates

* Response

* Shipping status

* Content due date

* Content received

* Advertising permission

* Final status



Please submit the spreadsheet as a Google Sheets link or Excel file.



Part 4 — Short Written Response



Please answer:



* How would you d
 whether a creator's video is suitable for paid advertising?

* What would you do if a creator did not respond after the first message?

* How would you manage 200–300 creators without losing track of conversations?

* What AI tools would you use in this role, and how?



Applications that do not include the exercise may not be considered.

description:

ABOUT US

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

I want someone who lives and breathes content. You love strategy, you love building something, and you get excited when a video takes off and want to know why. You don’t just wait for instructions. You bring your own ideas, your own take, and you’re not afraid to say “I think we should try this”. WHAT YOU’LL DO

Research what’s working in our niche and beyond, then create TOF content to trial

Research trends, sounds, formats and competitors

Review analytics weekly: what worked, what flopped, why, and what we test next

Bring content ideas and suggestions based on what’s performing

Prepare captions and posting details

Keep the content calendar and folders organised

2+ years of short-form video editing for social media (CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar)

Experience with Instagram trial Reels or content testing

Canva skills for carousels and static posts

An understanding of hooks, pacing and audience retention

To be proactive and keep working when you’re waiting on feedback, not sit idle

Clear, reliable communication, including short daily updates on Slack

title: Experienced B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter | $8–$10/hr + Bonuses | US Recruiting Firm
description:
**ABOUT WAYMARK HR GROUP**



Waymark HR Group is a growing recruiting and HR consulting firm based in Western New York, USA. We help small and medium-sized businesses find qualified employees, overcome hiring challenges, and take the recruiting burden off business owners.



Our founder has nearly 15 years of HR experience and understands the challenges employers face when trying to attract and hire the right people.



We are looking for an experienced, confident, and results-driven B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter to help us grow our client base.



This is an opportunity to work directly with the founder of a growing American business, with the potential for additional hours, increased earnings, and a long-term working relationship based on performance.



**ABOUT THE POSITION**



Your primary responsibility is to contact U.S. businesses that are actively hiring, identify employers who could benefit from our recruiting services, and schedule qualified introductory meetings with our founder.



You will NOT be responsible for closing sales, negotiating contracts, recruiting candidates, or collecting payments.



We are looking for someone who can have genuine business conversations, build trust, overcome objections, and create interest without sounding robotic or overly aggressive. (THIS IS IMPORTANT!)



**COMPENSATION & SCHEDULE**



- $8–$10 USD per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.

- $25 USD bonus for every qualified appointment that takes place.

- $100 USD additional bonus for every successful recruiting placement generated through your outreach once the client has paid Waymark.

- 20 hours per week.

- Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

- Fully remote.

- Initial paid 30-day trial period.

- Opportunity for additional hours and long-term work based on performance and business needs.



This is NOT a commission-only position. You will receive hourly compensation in addition to performance bonuses.



**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**



- Make outbound cold calls to U.S. businesses using provided prospect lists.

- Navigate gatekeepers and connect with business owners, presidents, hiring managers, HR leaders, and other decision-makers.

- Introduce Waymark HR Group and professionally communicate the value of our recruiting services.

- Ask qualification questions to understand an employer's current hiring needs and challenges.

- Handle common objections with confidence and professionalism.

- Schedule qualified introductory meetings directly on the founder's calendar.

- Follow up with interested prospects who are not ready to schedule an immediate meeting.

- Accurately document call outcomes, conversations, and follow-up activities.

- Maintain organized prospect records and provide a brief daily activity report.

- Participate in occasional training, feedback, and call-review sessions.

- Respect requests not to be contacted again and follow company outreach procedures.



**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**



- At least two years of experience in B2B cold calling or outbound appointment setting targeting U.S. businesses.

- Excellent spoken English that is clear, natural, professional, and easily understood by U.S. business owners.

- Strong listening and conversational skills.

- Experience navigating gatekeepers and reaching decision-makers.

- Strong objection-handling skills and the ability to think quickly during conversations.

- Confidence speaking with business owners and senior-level professionals.

- Ability to handle rejection while maintaining a positive and professional attitude.

- Experience using CRM systems, spreadsheets, or outbound calling software.

- Strong attention to detail, reliability, and personal accountability.

- Ability to work independently without constant supervision.

- Reliable internet connection, quality headset, and a quiet working environment.

- Consistent availability during the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule.



**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**



Experience in any of the following areas is highly desirable but not required:



- Recruiting or staffing agency business development.

- HR services or professional services sales.

- B2B sales development.

- Manufacturing, construction, skilled trades, or professional services.

- Selling services to small and medium-sized U.S. businesses.



**WHAT WE PROVIDE**



- Targeted business prospect lists.

- Company-provided calling software.

- Cold-calling scripts and objection-handling guidance.

- Training on our company, recruiting services, and target clients.

- A defined appointment-setting process.

- Direct access to the founder for questions, feedback, and support.

- Fair hourly compensation with meaningful performance incentives.



**WHAT COUNTS AS A QUALIFIED APPOINTMENT?**



A qualified appointment is a scheduled meeting with a business owner or appropriate hiring decision-maker at a company that meets our target client criteria, has a legitimate hiring need, understands the purpose of the meeting, and attends the scheduled conversation.



A sale is NOT required for you to earn the $25 qualified appointment bonus.



**HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS**



We value quality over quantity.



While consistent outbound calling activity is important, we are primarily interested in meaningful conversations, qualified business opportunities, appointments that take place, and accurate follow-up.



We want someone who takes pride in their work and understands that every conversation represents our company's reputation.



**HOW TO APPLY**



Please begin your application with the words "WAYMARK GROWTH" so we know you have read the complete job description.



Include the following:



1. A brief introduction and summary of your U.S. B2B cold-calling experience.



2. The industries you have previously targeted and the types of decision-makers you have contacted.



3. Your previous performance results, including average calls made, appointments booked, and appointments attended per week, if available. Please distinguish cold outreach from warm or inbound leads.



4. The CRM systems and calling software you have experience using.



5. Your desired hourly rate, earliest available start date, and confirmation that you can work Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.



6. A link to a 60–90 second voice recording containing the following:



- Briefly introduce yourself and describe your relevant experience.

- Imagine you are calling the owner of a U.S. manufacturing company that has been advertising an open position for several weeks. Introduce yourself as a representative of Waymark HR Group and demonstrate how you would start that conversation.



Please use your natural speaking voice. We are evaluating communication, confidence, professionalism, and your ability to engage a business owner, not your ability to read a prepared script.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to participate in a video interview and live cold-calling role-play.



We are looking for an experienced sales professional who wants to contribute to the growth of an American recruiting firm and be rewarded for producing meaningful results.



NEW leads are added DAILY. We just need someone who is professional, hungry, and wants to make $$$$!



If that sounds like you, we look forward to hearing from you!

* Organize
s, respond to inquiries, and coordinate follow-ups.

* Help ensure files are complete and organized according to company procedures.

4. SOPs & Business Process Management



A strong understanding of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) is essential.



* Follow existing SOPs accurately and consistently.

* Create, document, update, and improve SOPs.

* Develop checklists and repeatable workflows.

* Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend improvements.

* Ensure recurring tasks are completed according to established procedures.

* Help build systems that make multiple businesses easier to manage and scale.



5. Project & Multi-Business Coordination



* Manage multiple projects and competing priorities.

* Track tasks using project management software.

* Coordinate with internal teams, contractors, and external partners.

* Monitor deliverables and provide status updates.

* Anticipate potential problems and escalate issues promptly.

* Assist with additional administrative and operational responsibilities as needed.



Required Qualifications



* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, Operations Coordinator, or Administrative Assistant.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

* Demonstrated experience working with SOPs and structured workflows.

* Ability to multitask across different businesses.

* Proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.

* Experience with CRM systems and task management platforms.

* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive business information.

* Strong problem-solving skills and independent judgment.

* Reliable internet connection and professional remote workspace.



Preferred Qualifications



* Experience supporting U.S.-based real estate businesses.

* Familiarity with U.S. mortgage lending and loan processing workflows.

* Experience with transaction coordination.

* Knowledge of tools such as Follow Up Boss, Salesforce, HubSpot, Monday.com, Asana, Trello, or ClickUp.

* Experience creating SOP manuals and process documentation.

* Experience supporting multiple companies or executives simultaneously.



What We’re Looking For



We want someone who is:



* Proactive: Takes initiative instead of waiting for instructions.

* Accountable: Owns tasks and follows through until completion.

* System-Oriented: Understands the importance of SOPs, checklists, and efficient workflows.

* Adaptable: Can transition between real estate, mortgages, and other business operations.

* Resourceful: Researches solutions and solves problems independently.

* Detail-Oriented: Produces accurate, high-quality work.

* Dependable: Meets deadlines and communicates consistently.



How to Apply



To be considered, please submit:



1. Your updated resume.

2. A brief introduction describing your relevant experience.

3. Your experience working with real estate and/or mortgage companies.

4. An example of an SOP you have created, improved, or followed.

5. The software and CRM systems you have used.

6. Your expected monthly salary in USD.

7. Your availability to work U.S. business hours.



Important: Begin your application with the words “OPERATIONS EXPERT” so we know you carefully read the job description.



We are looking for a long-term team member who can grow with our businesses and become an essential part of our daily operations.

title: Virtual Home Health Quality Assurance Coordinator
description:
Schedule: Monday - Friday, 3:00 PM - 12:00 AM PST (Tuesday–Saturday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM Philippine Time), with a 1 hour break

Employment: Full-Time, Long-Term Remote Position



A new and growing United States-based, Medicare-certified home health agency, operational for less than one year, is seeking an experienced, organized, and detail-oriented Virtual Home Health Quality Assurance Coordinator.



A clinical background is required for this position.



The ideal candidate will have experience reviewing clinical documentation for a United States-based home health agency and be familiar with the Medicare Conditions of Participation, home health regulatory requirements, and CHAP accreditation standards.



The selected candidate will support the agency’s Quality Assurance and compliance program by reviewing clinical records, identifying documentation deficiencies, monitoring required corrections, and helping ensure that patient records meet Medicare, regulatory, accreditation, and agency standards.



We are seeking a dependable professional who can communicate respectfully with clinicians, manage multiple priorities, and support the agency's commitment to quality patient care, regulatory compliance, and survey readiness.



Required Qualifications

•	Clinical background required.

•	Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

•	Excellent attention to detail, organization, follow-up, and time management.

•	Ability to identify inconsistencies in assessments, physician orders, plans of care, and clinical documentation.

•	Ability to address documentation concerns professionally and respectfully.

•	Strong multitasking skills and ability to manage competing priorities.

•	Proficiency with EMRs,
, spreadsheets, virtual meeting platforms, and document management systems.

•	Ability to work independently while remaining accountable to leadership.

•	Reliable computer, secure high-speed internet, quiet workspace, backup internet, and backup power source.

•	Full-time availability during California Pacific Time business hours.



Preferred Experience

•	Experience with a U.S.-based Medicare-certified home health agency.

•	Knowledge of Medicare Conditions of Participation and home health regulations.

•	Experience with CHAP accreditation standards and survey preparation.

•	Background in Quality Assurance, clinical documentation review, compliance, utilization review, case management, or chart auditing.

•	Familiarity with OASIS, physician orders, plans of care, face-to-face documentation, homebound status, and skilled-need requirements.

•	Experience reviewing nursing, therapy, and interdisciplinary clinical documentation.

•	Experience with pre-billing chart reviews and documentation correction tracking.

•	Knowledge of survey readiness, audit preparation, and performance improvement.

•	Experience with ADRs, Medicare audits, Synergy, and Joint Commission documentation.



Primary Responsibilities

•	Review home health records for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timely submission.

•	Review OASIS assessments, physician orders, plans of care, face-to-face documentation, medication profiles, assessments, and visit notes.

•	Validate documentation supporting skilled need, homebound status, diagnoses, ordered services, and the plan of care.

•	Identify missing, incomplete, conflicting, vague, late, or noncompliant documentation.

•	Ensure compliance with Medicare regulations, agency policies, and accreditation standards.

•	Communicate documentation corrections clearly and professionally.

•	Track outstanding corrections and follow through to completion.

•	Verify corrected documents are properly completed, dated, and signed.

•	Assist with pre-billing reviews, chart audits, compliance monitoring, quality reporting, and performance improvement activities.

•	Maintain QA logs, audit tools, correction trackers, and pending-documentation reports.

•	Support preparation for CHAP surveys, Medicare reviews, and regulatory audits.

•	Identify recurring documentation issues and recommend educational opportunities for clinicians.

•	Maintain HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality.

•	Participate in virtual meetings, training, quality initiatives, and workflow improvement efforts.



Applicants with strong clinical and home health backgrounds may be considered if they demonstrate the ability and willingness to learn Medicare and CHAP requirements.



Preferred Candidate

The ideal candidate will be:

•	Experienced in U.S. home health Quality Assurance.

•	Knowledgeable about Medicare home health documentation and compliance requirements.

•	Familiar with OASIS, plans of care, physician orders, and clinical documentation.

•	Experienced with ADRs, Medicare audits, Synergy, and Joint Commission documentation.

•	Able to provide clear, accurate, and respectful feedback.

•	Organized, dependable, and deadline-oriented.

title: Direct Response Video Editor + Bonus on Every Winning Ad
description:
If you're a good editor, you already know what most editing jobs look like.



You get a brief. You cut it. You send it. You never find out if it worked.



And a year later, you're the same editor you were when you started.



This isn't that job.



We're North Star Brands. We build e-commerce brands in health and wellness, and we're about to grow faster than we ever have.



Which means there's room for a few good editors to grow with us. Into a bigger role, better work, and better pay.



HOW WE WORK



Here, every cut has a reason.



We care about why a clip is there, what it makes the viewer feel, and what it gets them to believe. If you can't say why a shot is in the ad, it probably shouldn't be.



And we want that at speed. High quality, and a lot of it.



WHAT YOU GET



• Real growth. Three months in, we want you to look back at the editor you were and barely recognise them.

• A path you can earn. Editor, then lead editor, then creative strategist, if you put the work in.

• You'll be ahead of AI, not replaced by it. AI is changing this job fast. We're bringing agentic video editing (editing with AI agents like Claude) into how we work. We're learning it as a team, and we'll train every editor on it.

• You'll see your results. You get the numbers on every ad you edit, we teach you how to read them, and you get paid when your ads win.

• You'll learn the strategy, not just the edit. Every week the team goes through what won, what lost, and why.

• We invest in your growth. Courses, resources, the best workflows out there: if it makes you better, we'll get it for you. We're plugged into the best e-com programs and people.



WHAT YOU'LL EDIT



• Mostly AI ads: AI movie dramas and AI animations.

• VSLs and talking-to-camera story ads.

• Some motion graphics, so you need to know After Effects, or at least be comfortable in it.



Briefs come from our creative strategists. There's enough work to fill a full 8-hour day, and we track both speed and quality.



YOU'RE WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR IF



• You've edited direct-response ads, and you know the edit's job is to sell.

• You have taste. You know when a shot holds too long or the music is wrong, without being told.

• You think about the marketing, not just the timeline.

• You're hungry and humble. You take feedback once and don't need it twice.

• You do the right thing without being told, like finding a faster way to work and sharing it with the team.

• You want to build something big, and grow into a bigger role while you do it.

• You want one company to go all in on.



THIS ISN'T FOR YOU IF



• You're juggling other clients. This is full-time and exclusive: one company, nothing on the side.

• You want a calm, easy 9-to-5.

• You want to cut what you're sent and log off.

• You're here for the paycheck until something better comes along.

• You're just starting out. We're not teaching editing from scratch.



PAY



• $2,000 to $2,500 USD a month. Full-time and exclusive, 5 days a week, fully remote.

• Plus performance bonuses on the ads that win. $200 to $500 for every winning ad that hits its KPI. No cap: the more winning ads you make, the more you earn.



If you've read this far, the keyword is "Straight Spine". The form will ask for it.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here (about 10 minutes):





Have these ready:



1. Your portfolio: 3 to 5 direct-response ads. Make sure the links open without us requesting access.

2. A 3 to 5 minute Loom, camera on, made for this job. It's a mini interview: the form tells you exactly what to cover, including three questions you answer out loud. READ IT CAREFULLY. Looms that skip anything aren't reviewed.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. We review every application.

2. A short trial edit.

3. A call.



We reply by
, so check your spam folder. If you hear from us, reply within 24 hours.



P.S. If you read all of this and felt like it was written for you, it probably was. Apply today. We move fast.

title: Meta Ads, Google Ads & Social Media Expert (E-commerce Sales, Oman)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

I run two e-commerce stores in Oman, Boothat and Ardor, selling personal-care and wellness products. Some of these products are sensitive under Meta and Google advertising policies. I need one person who owns paid advertising and turns it into real sales, not just clicks. This is a long-term role for someone who can work independently.



PRIORITY RESPONSIBILITIES (in order)

1. Own Meta Ads 
 + Instagram) for both stores: plan, launch, test, and scale campaigns for sales (purchases), not traffic.

2. Keep ad accounts safe and approved. Write compliant ad copy, creatives, and landing-page wording for sensitive categories, and handle policy rejections and appeals.

3. Set up and verify tracking (Meta Pixel + Conversions API, Google tag/GA4) on a local Omani store platform (not Shopify), and confirm purchases are measured correctly before spending.

4. Run Google Ads (Search and Shopping/Merchant Center where policy allows) for high-intent buyers in Oman.

5. Build the creative testing plan: angles, hooks, and offers, and brief my designer. Tailor creatives to Oman (Arabic/English, Instagram-first behavior).

6. Manage budgets by profit, not just platform ROAS: ad spend must stay inside product margin, and selling prices cannot exceed market prices in Oman. Flag products where ads are not profitable.

7. Use offers that fit our delivery rules (delivery fee inside vs outside Muscat, free-delivery threshold) in ad messaging and retargeting.

8. Set up retargeting (cart abandoners, product viewers, past buyers).

9. Support Instagram content: weekly content ideas, captions, and hashtags aligned with the ads.

10. Report weekly: spend, purchases, revenue, ROAS, cost per purchase, and what you will stop, change, or scale next.



REQUIREMENTS

- Proven e-commerce product-sales results on Meta (not only lead generation).

- Hands-on experience with restricted or sensitive ad categories (health, personal care, wellness) and policy appeals.

- Pixel + Conversions API experience on non-Shopify stores.

- Google Ads experience (Search, Shopping, PMax) is a strong plus.

- Advanced English. Arabic is a bonus.

- Able to overlap with Oman business hours (GMT+4).



TOOLS

Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Merchant Center, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Canva or CapCut, Google Sheets.



HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

- Purchases and revenue from ads, and ROAS above break-even after delivery and product cost.

- Ad account health (low rejection rate, no account bans).

- Correct tracking: ad-reported purchases match store orders.

- Clear weekly reports with decisions, not just numbers.



WHAT TO INCLUDE IN YOUR APPLICATION MESSAGE

1. 2-3 e-commerce case studies: ad spend, revenue, ROAS, period, and business type. Screenshots from Ads Manager are welcome (client names can be hidden).

2. The largest monthly Meta budget you have managed.

3. Your experience with sensitive categories and how you handled ad rejections.

4. How you would set up Pixel + Conversions API on a non-Shopify store.

5. Your availability.



START

Paid 2-week trial on a small ad budget, then a long-term role if results are good. Payment will be discussed with shortlisted applicants.



IMPORTANT - HOW TO APPLY (2 steps)

Step 1: Apply here on OnlineJobs.ph through this job post. Start your application message with the word: APPLY, and mention the name "Ibrahim". Applications without the word APPLY will be skipped.

Step 2: After you apply on the site, message me on WhatsApp: 
In your WhatsApp message, write: "APPLY - [your full name]" so I can match you with your application.

I will personally reply to the applicants who meet the requirements.

ABOUT US

The Mailroom Barber Co is a barbershop in Greenville, SC that also sells its own handmade grooming products (shampoo, conditioner, styling powder, Matte Clay) online via Shopify. We're hiring one Google Ads specialist to manage paid search for both sides of the business.



WHAT YOU'LL BE WALKING INTO

We already have a live Google Ads account with real spend (~$750/month) running on the barbershop side. Your first job is NOT building from scratch — it's auditing and fixing it. The current "conversions" being tracked are almost certainly not real booked appointments (cost-per-conversion is far too low, $0.60-$2 each, for a real local-service lead), because our booking tool (Squire) is a third-party widget with no API — so there's no way to see when someone actually completes a booking. We just confirmed with Squire support that no API/webhook/Zapier integration exists. We're about to add click-tracking on the "Book Appointment" button as a proxy signal, but we want your professional opinion on the best way to optimize bidding around this constraint.



On the Shopify/ecommerce side (Matte Clay and our other grooming products), conversion tracking is clean and already working via Shopify's native integration — this part is more standard Shopping/Performance Max/Search management.



SCOPE OF WORK

- Audit and clean up the existing barbershop Google Ads account (campaigns, keywords, conversion actions, wasted spend)

- Build/optimize Shopping + Search + Performance Max campaigns for the Shopify grooming product line

- Recommend and help implement the best lead-tracking approach for the barbershop given the no-API booking tool

- Weekly optimization: bids, negatives, budget pacing across both accounts

- Short monthly report in plain English: spend, results, cost per result, what changed and why



REQUIREMENTS

- 2+ years hands-on Google Ads management, ideally both local lead-gen and ecommerce/Shopping experience

- Comfortable with Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking troubleshooting

- Can explain your reasoning in plain English — we are not Google Ads experts and want to understand your decisions, not just see a dashboard

- Available for a short weekly check-in call



COMPENSATION

Flat monthly retainer, $500-600/month to start (combined ad spend budget is roughly $1,000-3,000/month across both accounts), reviewed after 60 days based on results.



PAID TEST TASK (required before hire, $30 flat)

1. One-page written plan: how would you track barbershop booking conversions given the booking tool has no API or webhook?

2. Sample campaign structure for our "Matte Clay" product: ad groups, 15 keywords grouped by intent, 5 negative keywords, 3 responsive search ad headlines + 2 descriptions.



TO APPLY, PLEASE INCLUDE

1. A before/after result from a past account you managed — spend, conversions, and what you actually changed.

2. How would you track leads for a business whose booking tool has no API?

3. Would you run Performance Max or Search-only for the barbershop side, and why?

title: SENIOR BRAND, CREATIVE & UI DESIGNER
description:

About the Companies:

We operate two accounting brands serving growing businesses across North America, with annual revenues ranging from $2M to $50M.



Firm Five is a fractional accounting firm providing ongoing accounting and financial support to growing businesses. We focus on building strong client relationships and delivering personalized financial services.

About the Role:

We are looking for an exceptional Senior Brand, Creative & UI Designer who combines artistic talent, strategic thinking, and a strong understanding of modern branding.

This is not a conventional graphic design position. We want someone with the eye of an artist, the thinking of a brand designer, and the ability to turn creative concepts into polished, high-quality digital experiences.

You will take ownership of the visual identity of both companies across websites, social media, personal brands, marketing materials, presentations, proposals, and video content.

You should understand what makes a brand look established, credible, and memorable, particularly within the North American market.

We're looking for someone who can create original work, not simply assemble templates or rely on AI-generated designs. Your portfolio should demonstrate genuine artistic ability, excellent taste, and a consistent standard of execution.

We are looking for the best of the best. Someone who can elevate our brands, challenge existing ideas, and bring a high level of creativity to everything they produce.



Key Responsibilities



1. Brand Identity & Creative Direction

- Produce high-quality visual assets for digital campaigns and landing pages.

5. Video & Data Visualization

- Prepare assets in multiple formats, including vertical, square, and widescreen.

- Deliver organized, production-ready visual assets to the video editing team.



6. Creative Research & Concept Development

- Research leading North American brands, professional services firms, and SaaS companies.

- Identify creative trends and visual approaches that can strengthen our market positioning.

- Pitch original design concepts and content formats for both brands.

- Recommend creative approaches for client success stories, educational content, team features, and promotional materials.

- Bring fresh ideas and continuously look for ways to improve our visual identity.



Qualifications & Requirements:

- At least 3–5 years of professional experience in brand design, graphic design, UI design, or a related creative field.

- An exceptional portfolio demonstrating strong artistic ability, branding, and visual design.

- Experience creating professional brands or digital experiences for B2B companies, professional services, or SaaS businesses.

- A strong understanding of North American design aesthetics, branding standards, and target audiences.

- Excellent eye for typography, composition, color theory, layout, and visual storytelling.

- Experience developing brand identities and maintaining consistency across multiple platforms.

- Experience with website design, UI layouts, and digital interfaces.

- Strong experience creating social media graphics, LinkedIn assets, and personal branding materials.

- Proficiency in professional design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

- Ability to create original designs and artwork without relying on AI-generated outputs.

- Strong attention to detail and an uncompromising standard for design quality.

- Ability to translate business and financial information into clear, attractive visual content.

- Excellent communication, organization, and time management skills.

- Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines.

- Must have a reliable computer, stable internet connection, and a suitable work-from-home setup.



Nice to Have:

- Experience working with North American companies or international clients.

- Experience in accounting, finance, legal, or SaaS branding.

- Strong UI/UX design capabilities.

- Experience with website platforms such as Webflow, WordPress, or Hostinger.

- Knowledge of motion graphics and animated social media content.

- Experience developing brand guidelines from scratch.

- Illustration or other traditional and digital art skills.



How to Apply

We are looking for outstanding designers, and your portfolio will be one of the most important parts of your application.



Please submit:

1. Your updated resume.

2. A link to your professional design portfolio.

3. Samples of your best branding, graphic design, UI, and social media projects.

4. At least one example of how you helped transform or elevate a company's visual identity.

5. Before-and-after examples, if available.

6. A brief explanation of your creative contribution to the submitted projects, including which parts you personally designed.

7. A description of your experience designing for North American or international audiences, if applicable.



Important: We are looking for original creative work. AI-generated designs, AI-created portfolio samples, or portfolios consisting primarily of ready-made templates will not meet our expectations. We want to see your actual design skills, creative thinking, and artistic ability.

Applications without a portfolio and relevant work samples will not be considered.



Recruitment Process

1. Portfolio Review

We evaluate artistic ability, design quality, creativity, consistency, originality, and overall visual judgment.



2. Initial Interview

A discussion of your experience, creative process, previous projects, and approach to branding and design.



3. Live Portfolio Walkthrough

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to walk us through selected portfolio projects, explain their design decisions, and demonstrate their personal contributions.



4. Paid Practical Assessment

Candidates will complete a paid design exercise involving:

- Creating a personal LinkedIn banner aligned with one of our brands.

- Turning financial data into a polished, video-ready chart.

- Proposing three original creative content formats.

- Demonstrating their ability to create professional, original visual work.



5. Technical Assessment & Reference Checks

We will review computer specifications, work equipment, technical capabilities, and professional references.



What We Value:

We value exceptional creativity, originality, artistic judgment, and attention to detail.

We are not simply looking for someone who can follow instructions or produce graphics quickly. We want a designer who understands what great design looks like, knows how to elevate a brand, and takes genuine pride in their craft.

If you have the talent, taste, and creative ability to make brands stand out in the North American market, we'd love to see your work.

title: Multifamily Underwriting & Financial Modeling Tutor
description:
I'm a commercial real estate professional specializing in multifamily investment sales. I'm seeking a part-time private tutor to teach me multifamily underwriting and financial modeling the way it's taught in a university-level real estate development program — structured, rigorous, and built around a proper textbook curriculum.



This is a teaching engagement, not a one-off training session. I want someone who can guide me from fundamentals through a complete, self-built multifamily underwriting and waterfall model, with assessments along the way to prove I've actually learned the material.



At a glance:

• Role: Private tutor / instructor 

• Schedule: Twice per week (two 60–90 minute remote sessions)

• Format: Fully remote via Zoom/Teams with screen sharing and Excel work-alongs

• Rate: $5.5/hour USD (paid via Wise)

• Start date: Immediate, upon successful interview



What You'll Be Teaching:

A structured curriculum of your own proposal, modeled on a university real estate development / real estate finance program, working out of a recognized textbook (e.g., Peter Linneman's Real Estate Finance and Investments or comparable). You will propose the syllabus and textbook in your application.



Core topic areas:

1. Foundations — time value of money, NPV/IRR/MIRR, cap rates, NOI, basis points, leverage concepts

2. Multifamily underwriting — rent rolls, market rents, vacancy and loss to lease, operating expenses and expense ratios, capital expenditures, debt terms (amortization, DSCR, loan sizing), investor pro forma conventions

3. Financial modeling in Excel — building a complete multifamily acquisition model from scratch, with sensitivity tables, scenario analysis, and clean formatting standards

4. Waterfalls and syndication math — preferred returns, return of capital, catch-up tranches, promote/carried interest, IRR-hurdle-based distribution waterfalls for LP/GP structures

5. Development topics — land/entitlement basics, ground-up feasibility analysis, construction budgeting and draws, permanent loan takeout, developer profit and developer waterfalls



Curriculum Structure Requirements:

• University-style curriculum: You will map out a semester-style syllabus with weekly topics tied to assigned textbook readings before we begin.

• Work out of a textbook: Each session should build on assigned reading and problem sets.

• Quizzes: Short quizzes at regular mile markers (roughly every 3–4 weeks) covering prior material.

• Tests/exams: Longer assessments at major milestones (mid-program and capstone), including a hands-on modeling exam where I build or repair a model under time constraint.

• Capstone project: A complete multifamily acquisition model built by me from scratch, including an equity waterfall tab, reviewed and graded by you.



Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience underwriting or acquiring multifamily assets (e.g., work at an acquisitions shop, appraisal firm, brokerage, developer, or lending institution)

• Advanced, demonstrable Excel modeling skills (clean formula design, scenario toggles, waterfall logic — no copy-paste templates)

• Practical familiarity with distribution waterfall math and GP/LP structures

• Prior tutoring, teaching, or training experience required

• Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, and dual-screen setup for screen-share lessons

• Ability to commit to a fixed twice-weekly schedule for at least 3–6 months



Nice to Have:

• Familiarity with US markets and conventions (Argus, CoStar, or similar exposure is a plus but not required — this course is Excel-native)

• Experience building development / construction-draw models

• Textbook-honed problem-solving: you should be comfortable assigning and grading exercises from a real estate finance text



To Apply:

Please send

1. A resume

2. A brief summary of your multifamily underwriting/modeling experience (deals, roles, tools)

3. A proposed curriculum outline: the textbook you'd use, a week-by-week topic list

4. A sample of your modeling work (screenshots welcome; formulas visible)

5. Your availability (EST) and confirmation you can commit to two sessions per week

title: Experienced Credit Repair Virtual Assistant (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
Job details: Full-time, 40 hours/week, long-term, dedicated to Consumer Rights Solutions (CRS) only — one client. Work hours: Monday–Friday, overlapping US Central business hours (9am–5pm CT = 11pm–7am Manila). Location: Remote, Philippines. Work from a dedicated Windows VPS/RDP workstation we provide. Salary: $800/month flat (full-time). Payment direct via Wise. Company: Consumer Rights Solutions (CRS) — Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA.



About us: Consumer Rights Solutions (CRS) is a US credit repair and funding company based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. We help clients dispute inaccurate items on their credit reports with the three bureaus — Equifax, Experian and TransUnion — and guide them through funding readiness. We have a fully built, proprietary disputing software platform that generates and manages disputes. We are hiring our first dedicated disputing VA to run it daily.



The role — what you will actually do: This is not a build-the-system job. The software already does the heavy lifting. Your job is to learn it, use it accurately every day, and keep client files moving:

- Learn and use our disputing software daily to dispute client files

- Input and submit disputes on our platform, via LetterStream (mail) and via the CFPB portal, exactly as generated — no invented facts, no added claims, nothing outside the client file

- Log bureau and creditor responses, track what was removed vs. still reporting, and update each client file after every round

- Monitor dispute rounds, follow up on stuck or overdue items, and flag anything unusual to the owner

- Handle customer service as we scale: reply to client messages, give progress updates, collect documents, and keep clients informed

- Keep records clean and accurate — attention to detail matters more than speed

Because the software handles most of the disputing, disputing itself should take a fraction of your day. The rest is monitoring, logging, follow-up and customer service.



What we are looking for:

- 2+ years of hands-on credit repair disputing experience (not just admin) — you know the dispute cycle end to end

- Strong working knowledge of FCRA, the three bureaus, and the CFPB complaint process

- Experience with LetterStream or similar mail/dispute tools is a big plus

- Excellent written and spoken English — you will write to US clients

- Extremely detail-oriented and reliable: you follow a process exactly, double-check before submitting, and never guess at a client's facts

- Comfortable learning new software quickly and working independently once trained

- Stable internet, quiet workspace, and able to work hours overlapping US Central time

- Long-term mindset — we want someone who becomes part of the team, not a short-term gig



What we provide:

- Full training on our software and dispute process

- A dedicated Windows VPS / RDP workstation provided by us (standard user account — you do not need your own high-end PC)

- Direct pay via Wise, on time

- A growing role: as volume grows, this becomes the disputing + customer-service lead for the team



How to apply — please apply only via OnlineJobs.ph and answer all of these in your application:

1. How many years have you worked in credit repair disputing, and for how many clients at a time?

2. Which bureaus and tools have you used (Equifax / Experian / TransUnion, CFPB, LetterStream, Metro 2, etc.)?

3. Walk through one dispute round, step by step, from receiving a client file to logging the bureau response.

4. What is your expected monthly salary for full-time work, and are you available for hours overlapping US Central time?

5. Are you currently working for another client? (We need someone dedicated to CRS.)

Applications without answers to the questions above will not be considered.
