title: Video Editor for AI Movie and Animation Ads (Full-Time)
description:
If you're a good editor, you already know what most editing jobs look like.



You get a brief. You cut it. You send it. You never find out if it worked.



And a year later, you're the same editor you were when you started.



This isn't that job.



We're North Star Brands. We build e-commerce brands in health and wellness, and we're about to grow faster than we ever have.



Which means there's room for a few good editors to grow with us. Into a bigger role, better work, and better pay.



HOW WE WORK



Here, every cut has a reason.



We care about why a clip is there, what it makes the viewer feel, and what it gets them to believe. If you can't say why a shot is in the ad, it probably shouldn't be.



And we want that at speed. High quality, and a lot of it.



WHAT YOU GET



• Real growth. Three months in, we want you to look back at the editor you were and barely recognise them.

• A path you can earn. Editor, then lead editor, then creative strategist, if you put the work in.

• You'll be ahead of AI, not replaced by it. AI is changing this job fast. We're bringing agentic video editing (editing with AI agents like Claude) into how we work. We're learning it as a team, and we'll train every editor on it.

• You'll see your results. You get the numbers on every ad you edit, we teach you how to read them, and you get paid when your ads win.

• You'll learn the strategy, not just the edit. Every week the team goes through what won, what lost, and why.

• We invest in your growth. Courses, resources, the best workflows out there: if it makes you better, we'll get it for you. We're plugged into the best e-com programs and people.



WHAT YOU'LL EDIT



• Mostly AI ads: AI movie dramas and AI animations.

• VSLs and talking-to-camera story ads.

• Some motion graphics, so you need to know After Effects, or at least be comfortable in it.



Briefs come from our creative strategists. There's enough work to fill a full 8-hour day, and we track both speed and quality.



YOU'RE WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR IF



• You've edited direct-response ads, and you know the edit's job is to sell.

• You have taste. You know when a shot holds too long or the music is wrong, without being told.

• You think about the marketing, not just the timeline.

• You're hungry and humble. You take feedback once and don't need it twice.

• You do the right thing without being told, like finding a faster way to work and sharing it with the team.

• You want to build something big, and grow into a bigger role while you do it.

• You want one company to go all in on.



THIS ISN'T FOR YOU IF



• You're juggling other clients. This is full-time and exclusive: one company, nothing on the side.

• You want a calm, easy 9-to-5.

• You want to cut what you're sent and log off.

• You're here for the paycheck until something better comes along.

• You're just starting out. We're not teaching editing from scratch.



PAY



• $2,000 to $2,500 USD a month. Full-time and exclusive, 5 days a week, fully remote.

• Plus performance bonuses on the ads that win. $200 to $500 for every winning ad that hits its KPI. No cap: the more winning ads you make, the more you earn.



If you've read this far, the keyword is "Straight Spine". The form will ask for it.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here (about 10 minutes):





Have these ready:



1. Your portfolio: 3 to 5 direct-response ads. Make sure the links open without us requesting access.

2. A 3 to 5 minute Loom, camera on, made for this job. It's a mini interview: the form tells you exactly what to cover, including three questions you answer out loud. READ IT CAREFULLY. Looms that skip anything aren't reviewed.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. We review every application.

2. A short trial edit.

3. A call.



We reply by
, so check your spam folder. If you hear from us, reply within 24 hours.



P.S. If you read all of this and felt like it was written for you, it probably was. Apply today. We move fast.

title: Chief of Staff – Entrepreneurial, Fast-Moving Problem Solver
description:
About the Position



We are looking for an exceptional, highly driven Operations Manager who moves extremely fast, takes initiative, solves problems independently, and gets things done.

We are NOT looking for a passive manager who waits for instructions, needs constant supervision, or simply delegates tasks.

We want an aggressive, ambitious, hands-on leader with an entrepreneurial mindset who takes complete ownership of their responsibilities and consistently delivers results.

The ideal candidate is a natural problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, attacks challenges head-on, and figures things out without waiting for someone else to provide the answers.

Speed, execution, resourcefulness, and accountability are extremely important to us.



Key Responsibilities



- Operations Management: Oversee daily business operations, eliminate bottlenecks, improve efficiency, and ensure work gets completed quickly.

- Sales Management: Lead and support sales teams, improve conversions, increase revenue, and drive performance.

- Hiring & Recruiting: Identify, interview, hire, train, and manage high-performing employees.

- Project Management: Manage multiple projects simultaneously, establish priorities, coordinate teams, and ensure deadlines are met.

- Team Leadership & Accountability: Set expectations, track performance, follow up consistently, and address underperformance immediately.

- Problem Solving: Proactively identify problems, investigate solutions, make decisions, and take action without waiting for instructions.

- Process Improvement: Continuously identify opportunities to simplify operations, reduce costs, improve productivity, and increase profitability.

- Executive Support: Work directly with company leadership to execute important initiatives, manage priorities, and ensure projects move forward.

- Hands-On Execution: Personally jump into projects and tasks whenever necessary to get results.



Personality & Work Ethic – MOST IMPORTANT



We are specifically looking for someone with the following characteristics:

- Extremely Fast-Moving: Works with an exceptional sense of urgency and executes quickly.

- Aggressive Problem Solver: Attacks problems immediately and doesn't stop until a solution is found.

- Highly Proactive: Identifies what needs to be done and takes action without being told.

- Hustler Mentality: Ambitious, energetic, hardworking, and constantly looking for ways to accomplish more.

- Resourceful: Figures things out independently, even when faced with unfamiliar challenges.

- Action-Oriented: Spends more time executing than discussing or planning.

- Strong Leadership: Comfortable directing teams, making decisions, and holding people accountable.

- Highly Organized: Can manage numerous projects, employees, and priorities without losing track of details.

- Results-Driven: Focuses on measurable outcomes rather than simply completing assigned hours.

- Entrepreneurial Mindset: Thinks like a business owner and takes personal responsibility for results.

- Independent Thinker: Brings solutions, recommendations, and completed work instead of constantly asking what to do next.

- Hands-On: Willing to roll up their sleeves and personally do whatever is necessary to get the job done.



Required Experience & Qualifications



- Previous experience in Operations Management, Sales Management, Business Management, Project Management, Chief of Staff, or a similar leadership role.

- Experience as a high-level Executive Assistant supporting a CEO, founder, or entrepreneur is also welcome, provided the role involved significant operational responsibility and independent execution.

- Strong sales experience, preferably including managing salespeople or sales processes.

- Experience recruiting, interviewing, hiring, training, and managing employees.

- Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities.

- Proven ability to lead remote teams and hold employees accountable.

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

- Excellent organizational and time management skills.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Comfortable learning and using CRM systems, project management software, AI tools, and other business technology.



Who We Are NOT Looking For



This position is NOT a good fit if you:

- Wait for instructions before taking action.

- Need constant supervision or follow-up.

- Move slowly or struggle with urgency.

- Identify problems but don't propose solutions.

- Prefer delegating everything instead of getting involved.

- Avoid difficult conversations or holding employees accountable.

- Become overwhelmed when managing multiple responsibilities.

- Are primarily experienced in administrative tasks such as scheduling meetings, managing calendars, or responding to
s.



Who Will Excel in This Position



We want someone who wakes up every day looking for opportunities to improve the business, solve problems, and accomplish more.

Someone who sees a problem and immediately takes ownership of solving it.

Someone who can manage people, drive sales, hire talent, organize projects, and personally execute when necessary.

Instead of saying, "What would you like me to do?" we want someone who says, "I identified the problem, figured out the solution, and already took care of it."

We value people who are ambitious, independent, exceptionally productive, and motivated by achieving results.



How to Apply



Please submit a short 1–2 minute video introducing yourself, describing your relevant experience, and explaining why you're a great fit for this role.

Applications without a video will not be considered.

title: Real Estate Lead Manager (100% Inbound Leads – NO Cold Calling!)
description:

We are looking for a sharp, empathetic, and reliable Lead Manager to join our team full-time and be the first point of contact for homeowners who reach out to us.



Why You Will Love This Role

Zero Cold Calling: Every single lead you speak with has already submitted their information requesting an offer or callback. No dialing cold lists or getting hung up on all day.



Consultative, Human Approach: We don't use robotic, pushy telemarketing scripts. If you are a great listener who knows how to build genuine rapport and ask smart questions, you will thrive here.



Growth & Bonus Potential: Competitive base pay plus performance bonuses when the leads you qualify and book turn into closed deals.



Key Responsibilities

Speed-to-Lead Outreach: Call and text new inbound website/form leads within minutes of submission to maximize connection rates.



Seller Qualification & Discovery: Have natural, engaging conversations to uncover the seller’s true motivation, timeline, property condition, and price expectations.



Appointment Setting: Book qualified, high-intent homeowners onto the Acquisitions Manager’s calendar with complete, accurate notes so the closer is fully prepared.



Pipeline & Follow-Up Management: Maintain spotless organization inside REsimpli (our CRM)—logging detailed call notes, updating lead statuses, and consistently following up with warm leads who aren't ready to sell just yet.



Daily Reporting: Submit a quick end-of-day summary of dials, conversations, appointments set, and pipeline updates.



What We’re Looking For

Exceptional English Communication: Clear, natural spoken English with a warm, confident phone presence and strong written grammar for SMS/email follow-ups.



Active Listening & Empathy: You know how to guide a conversation by asking thoughtful questions rather than talking over the seller.



Real Estate & CRM Experience: Prior experience as a Real Estate Lead Manager, ISA, or Acquisitions Assistant in the U.S. market is strongly preferred. Experience using REsimpli is a major plus.



Reliable Remote Setup: A quiet, distraction-free workspace, quality noise-canceling headset, high-speed fiber internet, and a reliable backup power/internet plan.



*How to Apply (Please Read Carefully)*

We receive hundreds of applications and only review candidates who follow all three steps below:



Start your message subject line with the exact phrase: EZ Inbound Pro



Record a 45-to-60-second voice note (using Vocaroo.com or Google Drive with public access enabled) introducing yourself and telling us what makes a great conversation with a homeowner. Paste the link in your message.



Briefly tell us about your experience with U.S. real estate leads and which CRMs you have used.

title: Fundraising Research & Outreach Assistant
description:
# Fundraising Research & Outreach Assistant



### About the Project



I'm looking for a resourceful and proactive research and outreach assistant to help promote a charitable fundraising campaign supporting a family in the Philippines who is struggling to provide food and essential care for their beloved cats.



The family has been caring for their cats for more than five years, including rescued animals. They are currently experiencing financial difficulties, and we're looking for genuine people, organizations, and businesses that may be willing to support their situation.



This is a charitable fundraising initiative, not a business investment opportunity.



### Responsibilities



- Research potential individual donors, philanthropists, animal welfare advocates, and charitable organizations.

- Identify business owners, executives, foundations, and companies that may offer sponsorships or donations.

- Research pet food manufacturers, distributors, and businesses that may provide cat food or essential supplies.

- Find relevant decision-makers and their publicly available professional contact information.

- Identify potential supporters on LinkedIn and other professional platforms.

- Prepare personalized outreach messages and follow-ups.

- Help promote the fundraiser through relevant communities and networks.

- Maintain an organized spreadsheet of prospects, contact information, outreach status, and responses.

- Provide regular progress updates.



### Ideal Candidate



- Experience in lead generation, prospect research, fundraising, business development, or outreach.

- Comfortable researching philanthropists, business owners, executives, and organizations.

- Good written English communication skills.

- Able to write personalized, natural, and respectful outreach messages.

- Familiar with LinkedIn, Google Search, spreadsheets, and online research.

- Resourceful, organized, and detail-oriented.

- Able to distinguish genuine opportunities from suspicious offers or potential scams.



### Application Requirements



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Relevant experience in lead generation, research, fundraising, or outreach.

3. Examples of previous research or outreach work, if available.

4. Your expected hourly rate and availability.



### Practical Assessment



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short research exercise.



**Task 1: Fundraiser Promotion**



Review the campaign and prepare a natural LinkedIn post that could be shared to help spread awareness.



Fundraiser:





**Task 2: Find Three Potential Supporters**



Research three real people, organizations, or businesses that could potentially help this campaign.



For each prospect, provide:



- Full name or organization name.

- Current position or organization description.

- LinkedIn profile or official website.

- Why you believe they could be relevant to this campaign.

- Their publicly available professional contact channel, if available.

- A short personalized introductory message you would send.



We are particularly interested in people or organizations involved in philanthropy, animal welfare, pet food sponsorships, charitable giving, or community support.



**Task 3: Outreach Strategy**



Briefly explain how you would approach these three prospects and how you would encourage them to support or share the campaign without sounding pushy.



### Important



- All prospects must be real and independently verifiable.

- Do not invent contact details, positions, or organizational information.

- Do not send messages or make donation requests on our behalf during the assessment.

- Do not pay for access to donor lists or private contact information.

- We value quality research and thoughtful outreach over the number of contacts collected.



The assessment is intended to take approximately 30-45 minutes.



### Position Details



- Work arrangement: Remote

- Employment type: Part-time

- Working hours: [Insert hours]

- Compensation: [Insert hourly rate or agreed project rate]

- Start date: [Insert date]



If you're interested in using your research and outreach skills to help a meaningful cause, we'd love to hear from you.

We are seeking a driven, articulate, and customer-focused Agency Producer (Insurance Sales Person) to support the growth of our U.S. insurance agency. Serving as the front line of our sales team, you will connect with prospective clients over the phone, assess their coverage needs, and guide them smoothly from initial quote to bound policy. The ideal candidate pairs strong consultative sales instincts with sharp attention to detail, thriving in a goal-oriented environment while maintaining high standards of accuracy and service.



Responsibilities:



1. Conduct consultative sales calls with prospective U.S. customers to evaluate their insurance needs, explain coverage options clearly, and close new policies.

2. Gather accurate client information and process comparative quotes across multiple insurance carriers.

3. Review and compare rates, deductibles, and coverage terms to recommend tailored insurance solutions that align with each customer's needs and budget.

4. Guide clients through the policy processing stage, including completing applications, collecting required underwriting documents, coordinating e-signatures, and assisting with initial payment setup.

5. Manage and follow up on a consistent pipeline of leads, pending quotes, and referrals to maximize conversion rates.

6. Identify opportunities to cross-sell and bundle additional lines of coverage to provide comprehensive client protection.

7. Log all client interactions, quote details, and policy updates accurately within the agency's CRM and Agency Management System (AMS).

8. Coordinate with carrier representatives and internal operations teams to resolve underwriting questions and ensure seamless policy issuance.

9. Meet and exceed monthly sales goals, conversion targets, and quality standards while adhering strictly to U.S. insurance compliance guidelines and carrier underwriting rules.



Qualifications:



1. Work Setup: Willing to work 100% on-site on a night shift (aligned with U.S. business hours, office in Angeles City, Pampanga).

2. Experience: Proven background in insurance sales or consultative phone sales, preferably supporting a U.S. insurance agency (Personal or Commercial lines).

3. Communication Skills: Outstanding verbal and written English communication skills, with a natural ability to build rapport, listen actively, overcome objections, and explain policy terms clearly.

title: GoHighLevel & AI Operations Specialist (Claude + Meta Ads) – US Marketing Agency
description:
READ THIS FIRST: Please read the whole post. How to apply is at the bottom.



About us

WellnessLeads is a US marketing agency that helps med spas and aesthetic clinics get new patients. We run their Meta 
 and Instagram) ads and build their funnels in GoHighLevel. Then our in-house booking team calls every lead and books them in. We work with about 15 clinics across the US.



I'm Josh Steinberg, the founder. You'll work directly with me. Website: wellnessleads.co



The role

You'll do our client work using Claude (an AI assistant) plus the step-by-step processes and Notion guides we've already built. Claude does most of the building. Your job is to run it, check everything it makes, fix what it gets wrong, and finish the parts it can't do. Over time you'll make more of the day-to-day decisions yourself.



What you'll do each week

• Build offer landing pages and quiz funnels in GoHighLevel

• Set up new client campaigns in GHL: custom values, calendars, forms, workflows and funnels

• Write Meta ad copy and research competitor offers in the Meta Ad Library

• Build call scripts in Canva and booking-team SOPs in Notion

• Fix rejected Meta ads and resubmit them

• Register client phone numbers for A2P in GHL

• Prepare our weekly campaign review: pull the numbers, draft what's working and what isn't, and draft each client's update

• Keep our Notion guides up to date when something changes



That's the job. We won't pile unrelated admin work on top of it. If the role changes, we'll talk first and adjust your pay to match.



Must have

• 2+ years of GoHighLevel experience at a marketing agency (funnels, forms, calendars, workflows, custom values, snapshots)

• Hands-on Meta Ads Manager experience, including duplicating ads and reading delivery errors and rejections

• You use Claude or ChatGPT every day for real work and can show us an example

• Strong written English, because clients will read what you write

• A reliable computer, stable internet and backup power



Nice to have

• Experience marketing med spas, healthcare or wellness businesses

• Canva, Notion, Trello, Zapier, or Google Sheets and Apps Script



People who do well here

• Check AI's work instead of trusting it

• Make a decision once they have enough information, and explain why

• Bring a recommendation, not just a question

• Fix the process when something breaks, not just the one task

• Ask questions when something is unclear. I'd much rather you ask than guess



What success looks like

• After 30 days: you've run each of our main processes with my review, and your work needs only small edits.

• After 90 days: you launch new client campaigns end to end and fix ad rejections on your own.

• After 6 months: you run the weekly campaign review and send client updates, and I only step in for big decisions.



Pay and schedule

• $500–$1,300 USD per month, full time (40 hours a week), based on experience

• Paid twice a month, plus 15 paid days off per year

• Pay review at 90 days, then every 6 months

• Fixed schedule, Monday to Friday. At least 4 hours must overlap with 9am–5pm US Eastern, which is 10pm–6am Philippine time (9pm–5am from March to early November)

• Long-term role. We provide Claude and all the software accounts you need



Room to grow

As we add clients, this role grows into leading client delivery and training new team members.



How to apply

1.  Start your application message with the word EVOLVE.

2.  In 3–5 sentences, tell us about a GoHighLevel build you're proud of.

3.  Include a Loom video (3 minutes max) showing a GHL or AI workflow you built. Explain one decision you made in it.

4.  Attach your resume.



We won't review applications that skip any of these steps.



What happens next

1.  We reply to every shortlisted applicant within 5 business days.

2.  Shortlisted applicants do a paid test task (2–3 hours, $30 USD).

3.  Next comes a video interview.

4.  Last is a 2-week paid trial on real work, before a long-term offer.



Questions about the role are welcome. Send them with your application.

title: Tiktok Shop Editor
description:
# HIRING: TikTok Shop Performance Video Editor & Creative Strategist (Long-Term)



**Full-Time Opportunity | 5+ Videos Daily | Long-Term Position**



I'm a TikTok Shop content creator looking for a highly skilled, creative, and performance-driven video editor who understands **viral content, direct-response marketing, consumer psychology, and sales conversions.**



I'm not looking for someone who simply cuts clips, adds captions, and exports videos.



**I want someone who thinks like a marketer, understands why people watch and buy, and knows how to make content perform better.**



### 🎯 WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



**1. Viral Content & Retention Expertise**



- Understands proven viral TikTok frameworks and storytelling structures.

- Knows how to create powerful hooks, pattern interrupts, and engaging pacing.

- Understands viewer psychology and how to prevent people from scrolling away.



**2. Conversion-Focused Editing**



- Understands the difference between a video that gets views and a video that generates sales.

- Knows how to highlight pain points, product benefits, social proof, and buying triggers.

- Can strategically use B-roll, captions, sound effects, and visuals to reinforce the sales message.



**3. Creative Strategy & Script Analysis**



- Can analyze scripts BEFORE editing and identify weak hooks, unnecessary sections, or missed selling opportunities.

- Can suggest stronger angles, better storytelling, and improvements to the CTA.

- Understands how to improve a video's performance rather than simply following instructions.

- Can independently make creative decisions that strengthen the finished video.



**4. High-Quality Editing**



- Strong experience with TikTok Shop, UGC, and direct-response advertising.

- Excellent B-roll selection, visual storytelling, sound design, captions, and pacing.

- Every edit should serve a purpose, whether that's improving retention, explaining a benefit, or driving a purchase.



**5. Strong English Comprehension**



- Must understand spoken and written English very well.

- Must understand American slang, humor, natural speech, and emotional sales messaging.

- Must be able to communicate creative suggestions clearly in English.



### 📅 WORKLOAD & SCHEDULE



- **Minimum 5 completed videos per day.**

- **Average video length: 35-60 seconds.**

- Work 6 or 7 days per week, depending on your preference.

- Approximately 130–150+ videos monthly.

- Raw footage, scripts, and creative direction provided.

- Must maintain consistent quality and meet deadlines.

- Long-term, ongoing work for the right person.



### ❌ THIS POSITION IS NOT FOR YOU IF:



- You only know how to make basic caption edits.

- You rely entirely on generic CapCut templates.

- You add random effects without understanding their purpose.

- You cannot identify improvements in a script or video.

- You need instructions for every creative decision.

- You prioritize fancy editing over retention and sales.



### 💰 WHAT WE OFFER



- Consistent, high-volume paid work.

- Long-term opportunity with ongoing projects.

- Creative freedom to suggest improvements and test new ideas.

- Opportunity to grow alongside an established TikTok Shop creator.

- Compensation based on experience, skill level, and demonstrated performance.



### 📩 HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. **Portfolio:** Your 3 best short-form videos, preferably TikTok Shop, UGC, or direct-response advertisements.

6. **Availability:** Whether you prefer working 6 or 7 days per week.



**Shortlisted applicants must be willing to complete a PAID trial edit.**

I'm looking for a long-term creative partner who can help make videos go viral AND convert into sales.



**If you understand the psychology of selling through short-form content, I want to hear from you.**

title: US Life Insurance Appointment Setter – Outbound Calling, Neutral American Accent – Part Time
description:
ABOUT US

Desmos Life is an independent life insurance agency in Utah, USA, run by two licensed agents. We help American homeowners get mortgage protection and term life insurance, often with no medical exam.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Make a high number of outbound calls to US homeowners. Most are AGED LEADS: people who asked about mortgage protection months ago and haven't been helped yet. Some are fresh leads from our
 ads.

- Get past the first "who is this?", re-spark their interest, confirm a few basics (state, homeowner, rough age), and BOOK A PHONE APPOINTMENT with one of our licensed agents, or TRANSFER A HOT LEAD LIVE.

- Log every call in our CRM. It runs in Chrome and includes the dialer, so there's nothing to install.

- Set callbacks, and mark anyone who asks not to be called again.



You will NOT be selling insurance. You won't quote prices or give advice. Your job is strictly appointment setting and live transfers.



ENGLISH AND ACCENT: THE MOST IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT

Our leads are everyday Americans, many aged 40-65, and they hang up fast on callers they can't understand. We are ONLY hiring callers who sound clear, natural and easy to understand to an American ear.

- Near-native, fluent spoken English with a NEUTRAL, LIGHT ACCENT. Clear pronunciation (v/b, f/p, th) and natural American rhythm and intonation, not a read-from-a-script sound.

- You can handle fast talkers, Southern accents and interruptions without losing your place.

- You can make small talk and handle objections naturally.

- Strong accent? Please don't apply. We listen to every recording, and accent clarity is the first thing we screen for.



OTHER REQUIREMENTS

- At least 1 year of outbound calling to US consumers (insurance, final expense, mortgage, solar or appointment setting preferred)

- Comfortable with aged leads, high call volume and hearing "no" many times a day

- Stable internet (a backup connection preferred), a quiet room with no background noise, a computer with Chrome, and a noise-canceling USB headset

- Fast and accurate at typing call notes

- Reliable: you show up for every shift on time

-Based on performance, their is opportunity to transition to full time

SCHEDULE

Monday-Friday, about 6:00am-11:00am Manila time, 20 hours per week. That's 5-9pm in the Eastern US and Texas, when people are home from work. From March to November, US daylight time moves the shift one hour earlier.



PAY

$4-$5 USD per hour, depending on experience and how you sound on the phone.



HOW TO APPLY 

1. Start your message with the word "DESMOS".

2. Attach ONE voice recording, 2-3 minutes long, recorded with your work headset in the room you'd work from. In it:

   a) Introduce yourself and describe your US calling experience, talking naturally without reading.

   b) Read this opener the way you'd say it on a real call: "Hi, is this John? Hey John, this is Maria with Desmos Life. A while back you asked about protecting your mortgage, and I'm just following up. Did you ever get that taken care of?"

   c) Answer this objection the way you would on a call: "I don't remember filling anything out. Take me off your list."

3. Tell us your internet speed (a speed test screenshot) and whether you have a backup connection.

4. List your previous calling jobs: the company, what you called about, and for how long.



Shortlisted applicants will do a live 10-minute mock call with us over video, including a role-play with a skeptical homeowner, before any offer.

title: AI Outreach & Engagement Operator
description:
Purpose of the Role

Strategic VA builds and runs the system that turns LinkedIn attention into booked appointments. She sets up and maintains the AI tools, automated campaigns and scheduled tasks behind Sonja's outreach, engages personally with prospects as Sonja, and tracks what works so the team can sharpen its content and engagement strategy.



The pipeline starts on LinkedIn. Automated Dripify campaigns and personal engagement bring people in, and traffic flows to several destinations (webinars, Executive Roundtables, landing pages and the booking page) where people sign up to learn about cybersecurity, AI risk and AI governance. Strategic VA owns the process from first touch through the booked appointment.



We are looking for someone strategic and highly motivated who wants to help build an ecosystem of AI tools, not just follow a checklist.



Possible Schedule: 

Sun 6-8pm PST

Mon 5-10am, 6-9pm PST

Tues 5-10am, 6-9pm PST

Wed 5-10am, 6-9pm PST

Thurs 5-10am, 6-9pm PST 

Fri 5-10am PST, no Friday afternoon/evenings



Please propose a 20 hour weekly schedule. Ideally you will work a couple hours in the morning and a couple hours in the evening. This will enable us to stay on top of LinkedIn connection accepts and message replies. 



To be done during US business hours 



Core Responsibilities

- Build the System

- Set up and connect the tools that run outreach: Dripify, Sales Navigator, GoHighLevel, Trello or ClickUp, and an automation tool such as Make.

- Build AI agents and scheduled tasks with Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT and Copilot: lead research, reply drafting, list cleanup and reporting.

- Route new leads automatically into the contact database and the right follow-up sequence.

- Document each workflow so it can be maintained and improved.

- Run the Pipeline

- Launch and monitor automated LinkedIn campaigns, staying within LinkedIn's weekly invitation limits and the 50 monthly InMail credits.

- Send people to the right destination: webinar, Executive Roundtable, landing page or booking page.

- Run invitation, reminder and follow-up campaigns for each event.

- Move every interested lead through to a booked appointment with Sonja.

- Engage as Sonja

- Engage on prospects' profiles: like and comment on posts, and endorse skills.

- Reply to messages personally in Sonja's voice, warm, specific and direct.

- Recommendations only for people Sonja has actually worked with.

- Measure and Improve

- Track sends, acceptance rate, replies, sign-ups and appointments booked.

- Find the best days and times to post and engage.

- Build and refine personas: who engages most, when, and what they are curious about.

- Send a weekly report to Sonja and Renee with results and recommendations for content and engagement strategy.



Compensation

- First month: $500.

- Performance bonus: paid on top of base pay for strong results (see structure below).

- Longer-term opportunity: strong performance in the first month opens the opportunity to be hired on for a longer-term agreement, with ongoing pay of roughly $500 to $800 per month.



What Strategic VA Brings

- Strategic thinking and strong self-motivation

- Hands-on experience building automations and AI workflows

- Fluency with LinkedIn, Sales Navigator and Dripify (or similar)

- Experience with GoHighLevel or another CRM, and Trello or ClickUp

- Daily use of Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT or Copilot; Make or Zapier a plus

- Excellent written English and the judgment to write as Sonja

- Comfort with metrics and turning data into recommendations



Success Measures

- Systems live, documented and running reliably

- Steady growth in replies, sign-ups and booked appointments

- Every reply answered or routed within 12 hours

- Weekly report on time, with clear persona and timing insights

- Identify business owners, executives, foundations, and companies that may offer sponsorships or donations.

- Research pet food manufacturers, distributors, and businesses that may provide cat food or essential supplies.

- Find relevant decision-makers and their publicly available professional contact information.

- Identify potential supporters on LinkedIn and other professional platforms.

- Prepare personalized outreach messages and follow-ups.

- Help promote the fundraiser through relevant communities and networks.

- Maintain an organized spreadsheet of prospects, contact information, outreach status, and responses.

### Ideal Candidate



- Experience in lead generation, prospect research, fundraising, business development, or outreach.

- Comfortable researching philanthropists, business owners, executives, and organizations.

- Good written English communication skills.

- Able to write personalized, natural, and respectful outreach messages.

- Familiar with LinkedIn, Google Search, spreadsheets, and online research.

- Resourceful, organized, and detail-oriented.

- Able to distinguish genuine opportunities from suspicious offers or potential scams.



### Application Requirements



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Relevant experience in lead generation, research, fundraising, or outreach.

3. Examples of previous research or outreach work, if available.

4. Your expected hourly rate and availability.



### Practical Assessment



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short research exercise.



**Task 1: Fundraiser Promotion**



Review the campaign and prepare a natural LinkedIn post that could be shared to help spread awareness.



Fundraiser:





**Task 2: Find Three Potential Supporters**



Research three real people, organizations, or businesses that could potentially help this campaign.



For each prospect, provide:



- Full name or organization name.

- Current position or organization description.

- LinkedIn profile or official website.

- Why you believe they could be relevant to this campaign.

- Their publicly available professional contact channel, if available.

- A short personalized introductory message you would send.



We are particularly interested in people or organizations involved in philanthropy, animal welfare, pet food sponsorships, charitable giving, or community support.



**Task 3: Outreach Strategy**



Briefly explain how you would approach these three prospects and how you would encourage them to support or share the campaign without sounding pushy.



### Important

- Do not invent contact details, positions, or organizational information.

- Do not send messages or make donation requests on our behalf during the assessment.

- Do not pay for access to donor lists or private contact information.

- We value quality research and thoughtful outreach over the number of contacts collected.

Position: Interior Design Assistant

Department: Interior Design / Design-Build

Reports To: Lead Interior Designer / Design Director

Project Types: Spec Homes, Semi-Custom Homes, and Luxury Custom Residences

Position Overview

The Interior Design Assistant will support the design and construction teams in developing, documenting, and executing residential interior design projects. This position requires proficiency in SketchUp and AutoCAD, strong organizational skills, an understanding of residential construction, and exceptional attention to detail.



The ideal candidate will assist in transforming design concepts into accurate drawings, 3D models, material selections, and construction-ready documentation.



Our firm places a strong emphasis on interior design as a defining element of our homes. The Interior Design Assistant will play an important role in ensuring that design details are thoughtfully developed, accurately communicated, and consistently executed throughout construction.
